jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are building XTB – a global investment company offering innovative technological solutions that allow our clients to effectively manage their finances in multiple ways. All of this within a single, intuitive XTB app already used by over one million users worldwide!
We are a certified Great Place to Work company.

Who is a Senior Project Manager at XTB?

You are a key part of the PMO (Portfolio Management Office) within the Product & Technology (IT) department.
You drive end-to-end projects that cross multiple IT teams, non-IT departments, and external vendors.
You manage diverse initiatives (ranging from 1-2 months to 1-2 years), proactively adapting plans to ensure successful delivery.
You manage stakeholders at all levels (including SME, Corporate management, Consulting services, Trading, IT, and Accounting) and collaborate daily with Product Managers, Program Managers, and Team Leads.
You create, visualize, and update project roadmaps, taking full ownership of goal decomposition and documentation.
You organize the workflow effectively: you set up communication channels, approval processes, checkpoints, and documentation standards.
You proactively identify key risks, manage them methodically, and swiftly remove obstacles blocking the teams from delivering.
You lead workshops and working sessions, and you report project statuses to key stakeholders.
You create and implement processes based on data from Jira, BI, and DB to support the PMO and the broader Tech & Product department.

Requirements

Minimum 5 years of experience in IT, including at least 3 years as a Project Manager (or in a similar role).
A strong technical background and solid domain knowledge of financial products / fintech.
A project management certification (e.g., Prince2 or PMP).
Advanced proficiency in AI tools (Claude Code), JIRA, Excel, and Google Spreadsheets.
Solid understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and various IT specializations (FE, BE, QA, BA, Arch, UX, UI, PO, SM, DevOps).
Experience in agile product development (Scrum, Kanban) and cross-team collaboration.
Highly developed soft skills: assertiveness, effective communication, conflict resolution, and negotiation.
Process-oriented mindset, a high level of independence, and the ability to quickly grasp complex domain knowledge.
English proficiency of at least C1 level.

What We Offer

Real influence on the development of the company and the product.
Work in an experienced team that is happy to share its knowledge.
A clear vision of development thanks to regular feedback.

Benefits

A training budget for courses and conferences that interest you.
An extra day off on your birthday.
An extra day off for parents.
Equipment tailored to your needs.
Private medical care and group insurance.
Access to an e-learning platform for learning English and a benefits platform.
Access to a wellbeing platform and the opportunity to take advantage of workshops and private therapy sessions.
Remote work, from the office in Warsaw or from a coworking space in your city.

17,850 zł - 22,700 zł a month

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

SUMMARY:

As a Project Manager, you are the foundation of our delivery team, focusing on mid-sized technical projects. You provide critical visibility, service reviews, and reporting throughout the implementation lifecycle. You are a professional who moves fast to discover simpler ways to deliver results for our customers while adopting a deeply "Customer-Centric" mindset.

WHY THIS ROLE?

Impact: Own and manage the operational relationship with assigned clients, ensuring their applications scale to meet business needs.
Growth: This "Journey-Level" position provides a clear path toward advanced project management by mastering "zero-surprise" reporting.
Innovation: Work with bleeding-edge data warehouse technology in a truly disruptive software environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Project Governance: Maintain project documentation and track task effort in Smartsheet or Certinia.
Work Structures: Create granular Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and associate effort and resource naming to specific tasks.
Meeting Leadership: Lead internal and client meetings with thorough documentation and rigorous follow-up.
Conflict Management: Navigate internal resource conflicts effectively to keep projects on track.
Success Metrics: Maintain project margins within +/- 5% of target and achieve CSAT scores greater than 4.0.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

Typically 2-5 years of field experience in a services delivery or technical implementation role.
Bachelor’s degree required.
Proficiency in SQL basics, JIRA/Confluence, and fundamental Snowflake architecture.
SnowPro Core (required within 60 days of hire).
Fluent in English and local language fluency where required (any Scandinavian language or Dutch)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.description:
Join Us

Drive Fire Protection Excellence as Fire Sprinkler Project Manager
– Lead, Influence, and Deliver

Are you a proven project leader who thrives on managing high-profile fire protection projects from concept through completion? Do you enjoy building trusted client relationships, driving operational excellence, and delivering solutions that protect people, facilities, and mission-critical infrastructure?

CHA Consulting, Inc. is seeking a Fire Sprinkler
Project Manager
to join our Fire Protection Services Team
in Birmingham, AL; Cullman, AL; or remotely
. In this pivotal role, you will lead complex fire protection projects, oversee project performance, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients while helping shape the successful delivery of innovative fire and life safety solutions. This position is remote-flexible, with a strong preference for candidates located throughout the Southeastern U.S. to support our growing regional presence. The role includes occasional travel to project sites and client meetings as needed.

What You'll Do

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex fire protection projects, ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships and navigating technical, financial, and logistical challenges throughout the project lifecycle
Direct project scope development, schedules, budgets, change orders, and resource planning while maintaining project quality and profitability
Manage project financial performance, including forecasting, budgeting, cash flow, revenue tracking, and Estimates at Completion (EACs)
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and technical leaders to drive project success and achieve key milestones
Oversee contract administration, project documentation, client communications, and project reporting from kickoff through closeout
Develop and implement project-specific health, safety, and quality initiatives while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements
Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to junior project management staff and technical team members as projects grow in scale and complexity

What You Bring

High school diploma required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum of 9 years of fire sprinkler experience required, including at least 6 years of project management experience
Strong knowledge of fire protection systems, fire alarm installations, life safety requirements, and construction project delivery
Proficiency with design software (AutoCAD, HydraCAD, Revit, etc.) required
Demonstrated success managing client relationships, project financials, schedules, contracts, and project risks
Experience preparing change orders, project plans, work authorizations, and project closeout documentation
Strong understanding of NFPA code requirements, OSHA standards, and fire/life safety regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence project outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and management software required; knowledge of Deltek Vision preferred
NICET certification preferred; project management certification is a plus
Valid driver’s license required with the ability to travel as needed

Why You'll Love It Here

Lead high-visibility fire protection projects that protect facilities, critical assets, and the communities they serve
Play a key role in shaping project strategy, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and influencing successful project outcomes

Curious about the impactful work our Fire Protection Services team is doing? Discover our innovative projects and commitment to delivering fire and life safety solutions by visiting: CHA Fire Protection Services .

Salary Range

$110,000 - $125,000

Salary is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, specialty, training, and fair market evaluation based on industry standards.

Culture/EEO Statement

At CHA, we work every day to create solutions, help people, and improve our world, committed to creating and fostering excellence in our diverse and highly talented teams. Our teams continually strive to find better ways – always searching, never settling – to achieve extraordinary results. Our values around hiring, training, and community engagement reflect a company culture that is forward leaning , welcoming , and always pushing the limits of what is possible.

We as an organization celebrate the values of belonging and collaboration , and advocate for the full participation of all people in an environment free of discrimination. jobs.title: Senior SDLC Project Manager
jobs.description:
Quiénes somos

En h&k creemos que las grandes cosas se logran en equipo. Somos una consultora tecnológica
especializada en Microsoft, IA y consultoría con más de 30 años de experiencia en proyectos Cloud dentro del ecosistema de Microsoft
y la energía de un equipo joven que combina innovación, agilidad y excelencia técnica.
Con más de 200 profesionales, 1.100 empresas atendidas
y sedes en Barcelona, Bilbao, Cartagena y Madrid
, acompañamos a empresas líderes en su transformación digital en Europa y LATAM
. Lo hacemos desde una visión integral: ofrecemos soluciones end-to-end
en ocho áreas, que abarcan desde M365 y Azure hasta Copilot, Data & IA, desarrollo e innovación digital
, siempre poniendo la tecnología al servicio de las personas.
Somos Microsoft AI Cloud Solution Partner
en Infraestructura, Datos e IA, Innovación digital y de apps, Trabajo moderno y Seguridad, y contamos con especializaciones avanzadas
en Modern Workplace, Seguridad y Azure.
Pero más allá de las certificaciones o la tecnología, lo que realmente nos define es cómo trabajamos y con quién lo hacemos
. En h&k no hablamos solo de tecnología: hablamos de personas
. Aquí trabajamos codo con codo, compartimos éxitos y aprendemos de la mano cada día. Nuestra cultura se basa en la cercanía
, porque sabemos que la confianza se construye tanto con clientes como con las personas que forman parte de nuestro equipo.
Nuestro propósito es claro: multiplicar capacidades, multiplicar visión y multiplicar impacto
, siempre con un toque humano.
Smart tech, human touch
no es solo un lema, es nuestra forma de trabajar, de relacionarnos y de construir futuro, contigo.
¿Tienes experiencia en proyectos de desarrollo e integración de software, y te motiva utilizar agentes IA de SDLC para seguir creciendo? Buscamos un/a Senior SDLC Project Manager capaz de conectar negocio, delivery y tecnología para llevar proyectos de principio a fin.

Tu día a día en este rol:

Formarás parte de un proyecto interno de innovación centrado en la ingeniería de software agéntica
, orientado al diseño y desarrollo de soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial.

Trabajarás junto a nuestros perfiles técnicos especializados en desarrollo e Inteligencia Artificial a cargo de desarrollar y mantener nuestra solución agéntica de proyectos SDLC, siendo la persona responsable de integrar y utilizar dicha solución en los diferentes clientes
, aportando estructura, coordinación y seguimiento a los diferentes proyectos, asegurando que los diferentes equipos avanzan de manera alineada hacia los objetivos definidos.

En este puesto tendrás la oportunidad de:
Liderar proyectos en los que agentes de IA participan activamente en distintas fases del SDLC
, ayudando al equipo a definir cómo integrar estas capacidades en procesos de análisis, desarrollo, testing, documentación, revisión y mantenimiento del software.
Planificar y coordinar el proyecto de principio a fin
, ayudando a definir roadmap, prioridades, hitos y entregables.
Organizar y realizar seguimiento de las diferentes líneas de trabajo relacionadas con IA, desarrollo de software, datos e integración con sistemas ERP
.
Trabajar de forma cercana con desarrolladores, perfiles de IA y otros especialistas técnicos, comprendiendo las principales decisiones, dependencias y bloqueos del proyecto.
Traducir conversaciones y necesidades técnicas en planes de trabajo, tareas, prioridades y próximos pasos claros
.
Gestionar el backlog y asegurar que las iniciativas están correctamente priorizadas de acuerdo con los objetivos del proyecto.
Identificar riesgos, dependencias y posibles desviaciones, anticipándote a los problemas y coordinando las acciones necesarias para resolverlos.
Realizar el seguimiento económico de los proyectos que lideres, supervisando su margen directo
(ingresos, costes, horas imputadas y previsión a cierre frente a lo presupuestado) y proponiendo acciones correctivas ante posibles desviaciones.
Facilitar las reuniones de seguimiento y coordinación del equipo, asegurando que existen responsables, fechas y acciones claras.
Hacer seguimiento del avance del proyecto y mantener informados a los diferentes stakeholders.
Ayudar a definir y mejorar progresivamente la metodología de trabajo, procesos y dinámicas de coordinación del equipo.
Participar en un proyecto de IA aplicada con un alto componente de innovación
, en el que iremos explorando nuevas formas de automatizar procesos tradicionalmente complejos y muy dependientes del conocimiento humano.

Lo que buscamos:

Al menos 5 años de experiencia
gestionando proyectos tecnológicos, con experiencia demostrable en proyectos de desarrollo de software.
Experiencia gestionando proyectos a lo largo del Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
: requisitos, diseño, desarrollo, testing, integración, despliegue y operación.
Capacidad para desenvolverse y liderar equipos de ingeniería de software
y comprender conceptos relacionados con arquitectura de aplicaciones, APIs e integraciones, CI/CD, testing, releases, seguridad y observabilidad.
Conocimiento de cómo la IA generativa y los agentes de IA pueden incorporarse al ciclo de desarrollo de software, entendiendo sus posibilidades, limitaciones y dependencias.
Capacidad para comprender a alto nivel conceptos como LLMs, agentes de IA, RAG, grafos, tool calling, automatización y evaluación de sistemas de IA, sin necesidad de implementarlos técnicamente.
Experiencia estructurando proyectos complejos
, gestionando backlogs, prioridades, riesgos, dependencias, hitos y entregables.
Experiencia en el seguimiento económico de proyectos
: control de presupuestos, costes y horas, análisis de desviaciones y supervisión del margen.
Sea una persona organizada, resolutiva y con facilidad para comunicarse
tanto con perfiles técnicos como con stakeholders menos técnicos.
Tenga experiencia trabajando con metodologías ágiles y herramientas de gestión de proyectos Waterfall.
Nivel alto de inglés B2 o C1.

Será valorable:

Experiencia coordinando proyectos en fases tempranas, PoCs, MVPs o iniciativas de innovación donde los requisitos evolucionan a medida que avanza el proyecto.
Experiencia en la estimación y definición de precio de propuestas
de proyectos, tanto a precio cerrado como en modalidad de tiempo y materiales.
Conocimiento de herramientas como Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence o similares.

Lo que te ofrecemos:

Trabajo 100% remoto: trabaja desde el lugar de España que tú elijas. Viajes puntuales a cliente.
Contrato indefinido.
Clases de inglés gratuitas.

Ticket restaurante, transporte y guardería.
Participación en proyectos con empresas líderes a nivel mundial.
Formación continuada.

Revisión salarial continuada.

Colovore is the leader in ultra-high-density, liquid-cooled AI colocation data centers for the deployment of AI inference, SuperPod, and AI factory applications and solutions. The company was acquired by King Street in 2024, who provides real estate development expertise and secured $925 million funding to accelerate its national expansion. Join our team and play a critical role as we scale for rapid growth. You can be a game-changer at Colovore.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About Our Organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe Has Three Interconnected Extensibility Primitives

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.

Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

Background in product management or product operations
Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About Our Organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe Has Three Interconnected Extensibility Primitives

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.

Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

Background in product management or product operations
Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The Senior Engineering Program Manager leads cross-functional delivery of product development initiatives, including new product introductions, cost reduction, technology integration, and lifecycle product support. The Senior Engineering Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, connects decisions to business outcomes, and maintains visibility across programs within their product line or line of business. .

Own end-to-end delivery of assigned programs of moderate complexity through planning, execution, launch readiness, and closeout.

Frame trade-offs with clear options, impacts, risks, and recommendations to drive timely decisions when scope, schedule, cost, capacity, quality, customer needs, or downstream commitments conflict.
Translate product requirements and business objectives into clear delivery scope, milestones, and product realization plans in partnership with Product and Engineering.

Facilitate cross-functional alignment with documented outcomes, clear ownership, and proactive management of inter-team dependencies and conflicts.

Apply lessons learned, propose improvements to program management and NPD practices, and help drive adoption across the PgM team and supported business areas.

Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology or Management, Computer Science, or another directly engineering-related field.
10 years of progressive experience in engineering, product management, or a related field, including 8 years of program management experience leading cross-functional teams through end-to-end delivery.

Demonstrated experience managing new product development programs from end-to-end, using a phase-gate (or similar) development process.

PMP, PgMP, or related certification with demonstrated practical application.
Experience working with global teams, international suppliers, or distributed development and manufacturing organizations.

Brings structure to ambiguous cross-functional work and challenges unclear assumptions.
Builds program plans based on scope, assumptions, dependencies, trade-offs, critical path, and risk.

About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About The Role

We're looking for a GTM Project Manager to help bring IXOPAY's payment technology products and capabilities to market.

In this cross-functional role, you'll coordinate product launches and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring new capabilities are introduced with clear messaging, aligned teams, effective enablement, and measurable outcomes. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Client Success, you'll help turn product development into successful launches that drive customer adoption and business growth.

You'll take ownership of launch planning and execution, coordinate internal readiness, develop enablement materials, and track adoption and performance after release. You'll also help strengthen the processes, reporting, and collaboration that connect Product development with our commercial teams.

This is an opportunity to combine strong program management and communication skills with product strategy and go-to-market execution, helping shape how IXOPAY introduces innovative payment solutions to enterprise customers around the world.

What You'll Do

Drive Product Launches & GTM Readiness

Plan, coordinate, and execute go-to-market activities for new products, features, and capabilities using IXOPAY's product launch framework.
Own launch timelines, readiness checklists, deliverables, and cross-functional coordination from planning through go-live and post-launch review.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Client Success, and Partnerships to align priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure teams are prepared for launch.
Collaborate with Product and Marketing to develop accurate positioning, messaging, pricing inputs, and launch communications.
Identify risks, resolve blockers, and improve launch execution through structured planning and proactive communication.

Enable Sales, Solutions & Customer-Facing Teams

Develop and maintain product enablement materials, including launch briefs, FAQs, demo guides, release notes, and product updates.
Coordinate and support training sessions that help Sales, Solutions, and Client Success teams confidently communicate new product capabilities.
Translate complex technical product information into clear, practical resources for internal teams and customers.
Partner with Marketing and customer-facing teams to support product announcements, customer communications, and ongoing adoption initiatives.
Gather feedback from commercial teams to identify enablement gaps and opportunities to improve product understanding.

Coordinate Strategic Product Initiatives

Support cross-functional product programs involving internal teams, external technology providers, and strategic partners.
Coordinate deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder communication to keep initiatives progressing toward defined outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve product-to-GTM handoffs, launch processes, and cross-functional collaboration.
Support Product team operations, including planning meetings and workshops, maintaining documentation, and coordinating vendor-related activities.
Develop repeatable workflows and processes that improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across product initiatives.

Track Product Adoption & GTM Performance

Establish and maintain reporting that tracks product launches, adoption, enablement effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
Develop dashboards and regular updates that provide Product and GTM leadership with visibility into launch progress and outcomes.
Gather post-launch feedback from Sales, Client Success, customers, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement.
Partner with Product leadership to evaluate launch effectiveness, adoption trends, and opportunities to strengthen future GTM initiatives.
Use data and insights to continuously improve launch execution, enablement, and product adoption strategies.

What You'll Bring

Required

Experience in Project Management, Product Go-to-Market, Product Operations, Product Marketing, Program Management, Project Management, or a related role within a B2B SaaS or technology organization.
Proven experience coordinating cross-functional product launches or go-to-market initiatives from planning through execution and post-launch evaluation.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and competing deadlines.
Experience working collaboratively with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and customer-facing teams.
Ability to translate technical product information into clear, compelling, and practical communication and enablement materials.
Experience developing launch plans, tracking deliverables, managing dependencies, and identifying risks.
Strong analytical skills and experience using data to track performance, adoption, and operational effectiveness.
Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, spreadsheets, and reporting or business intelligence platforms.
Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and modern software development processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across distributed, cross-functional teams.
Professional fluency in English, including the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across the United States and Europe.

Preferred

Experience in payments, FinTech, financial infrastructure, or another complex B2B technology environment.
Experience bringing API-first, developer-focused, or enterprise SaaS products to market.
Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, payment processing, or related technologies.
Experience developing product enablement programs or supporting technical product launches.
Experience working with product adoption metrics, launch performance reporting, and customer feedback.
Experience supporting Agile product teams or coordinating software delivery initiatives.
Experience working across US and European teams and time zones.
Relevant certifications such as CSM, PSM, CAPM, PMP, or Pragmatic Institute.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help bring innovative payment technology to market, connecting product development with the teams and customers who rely on our solutions.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Marketing, and commercial strategy, helping introduce new capabilities across payment orchestration, tokenization, AI Payments Intelligence, and emerging payment technologies.

You'll have meaningful ownership of product launch initiatives, opportunities to improve how we bring products to market, and the ability to influence adoption and customer success across a global organization.

jobs.title: IT Growth Site Deployments Program Manager
jobs.description:
Eaton’s Corporate Sector division is currently seeking a IT Growth Site Deployments Program Manager. This position offers a hybrid work schedule and may be based in Arden, NC; El Paso, TX; Greenwood, SC; Raleigh, NC; Beachwood, OH; or Sumter, SC.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $130000 - $190000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Growth Site Deployments Program Manager to lead technology and digital deployments across Eaton’s Key Strategic Growth (KSG) sites. This role translates business priorities and capability roadmaps into integrated site deployment plans from readiness through cutover and stabilization.

The Program Manager will coordinate across site leadership, Continuous Improvement (CI), Digital and IT, Operations, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, solution teams, BRMs, and external partners. This role owns deployment execution, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, and governance.

This individual contributor will drive adoption, solve delivery challenges, and establish repeatable deployment practices that can scale across sites. Travel up to 25% is required based on deployment needs.

What You’ll Do

Lead complex technology and digital deployments across assigned KSG manufacturing sites from planning through stabilization.
Own integrated deployment plans, including scope, milestones, resources, budget, risks, dependencies, readiness, cutover, and sustainment.
Translate approved roadmaps and capability plans into actionable site-level deployment plans with clear ownership and outcomes.
Partner with CI, Digital and IT, Operations, site leadership, BRMs, and capability teams to coordinate execution and align commitments
Assess readiness across people, process, data, infrastructure, technology, training, and support; identify barriers and drive resolution.
Manage program funding, forecasts, resources, vendors, risks, issues, and dependencies while providing clear leadership reporting.
Track deployment outcomes, adoption, and operational performance in partnership with site and business owners.
Ensure deployments align with architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise standards while creating repeatable practices that can scale across sites.
Apply Lean and continuous improvement methods to simplify delivery and resolve issues at the source.
Use data, automation, and approved AI tools to improve planning, analysis, risk identification, decision-making, and reporting. Expected Outcomes and Success Measures
Deployments achieve defined scope, schedule, budget, adoption, and business objectives.
Sites demonstrate readiness and sustained adoption of deployed capabilities.
Risks, dependencies, and resource constraints are identified and addressed early.
Deployment practices are standardized and scalable across prioritized sites.
Program performance, financials, risks, and outcomes are clearly communicated to business and IT leadership.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 7 years of experience leading moderate to highly complex technology projects or programs.
Minimum of 3 years of experience managing integrated project or program plans that include schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and resources.
Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering technology or digital capabilities within manufacturing, industrial, operations, or similarly complex operating environments.
Minimum of 2 years of experience coordinating multi-site deployments or the deployment of repeatable technology solutions across multiple locations.
Must currently reside within a 50-mile radius of Arden, NC; El Paso, TX; Greenwood, SC; Raleigh, NC; Beachwood, OH; or Sumter, SC.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.
Must be able and willing to travel up to 25% to assigned manufacturing and business sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering technology or digital capabilities within manufacturing or operations environments.
Experience scaling proven technology or digital solutions across multiple manufacturing sites.
Working knowledge of enterprise applications, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, integrations, and operational support dependencies.
Strong knowledge of program management principles, methodologies, and tools.
Experience managing program funding, forecasts, resource plans, and vendor commitments.
Experience partnering across IT, Digital, Operations, Continuous Improvement, site leadership, and other matrixed functions.
Continuous improvement experience using methodologies such as A3, DMAIC, value-stream mapping, Lean/EBS, or root-cause problem solving.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or comparable continuous improvement certification.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, or comparable project/program management certification.
Experience using modern AI productivity tools to accelerate analysis, planning, documentation, and delivery.
Experience supporting technology deployments involving enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure, and integration requirements.

Skills

Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical information into clear business terms.
Ability to organize complex work already in motion and make thoughtful adjustments that accelerate outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, establish accountability, and coordinate cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization.
Strong judgment, structured problem-solving, conflict resolution, and a pragmatic, results-driven approach.
Business and financial acumen with an understanding of how technology deployments affect safety, quality, capacity, speed, customer commitments, and growth.
Continuous improvement and digital mindset with a willingness to engage directly with site and frontline teams, understand work at the point of execution, resolve issues at the source, and create repeatable solutions.
Ability to use data, digital capabilities, automation, and approved AI tools responsibly to improve execution and decision-making.
Ability to work effectively across diverse, global teams, cultures, and organizations.

jobs.description:
Du möchtest deine Talente entfalten, deine Stärken beweisen, deine Ideen einbringen? Als ein führender europäischer Anbieter von Finanz- und Vorsorgelösungen unterstützen wir mit Leidenschaft Menschen, finanziell für sich zu sorgen – ein Leben lang. Das Know-how und die Leidenschaft unserer Mitarbeitenden ist dabei die Grundlage unserer Erfolge. Deshalb fördern und unterstützen wir auch dich individuell und bedarfsgerecht sowohl in deiner persönlichen als auch bei deiner beruflichen Entwicklung.

Suchst du eine Karriere mit Zukunft? Dann herzlich willkommen bei Swiss Life!

Aufgaben

Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst Großvorhaben auf der IT-Seite – inklusive Budgetverantwortung und enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen

Gemeinsam mit den Stakeholderinnen und Stakeholdern erarbeitest und aktualisierst du laufend die Programm-Roadmap und koordinierst programmweite sowie -übergreifende Abhängigkeiten

Die Verantwortung für Programm-Governance, Change- und Risikomanagement liegt in deinen Händen

Du sorgst für eine aktive, transparente und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation sowie ein regelmäßiges Reporting über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg – auch in Richtung der Swiss Life Gruppe

Fortschritt, Meilensteine, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten machst du für alle Beteiligten jederzeit nachvollziehbar und steuerst die Priorisierung relevanter IT-Vorhaben aktiv mit

Zudem koordinierst du die IT-relevanten Programmaktivitäten und stellst eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit zwischen allen beteiligten Teams sicher

Profil

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit IT-Bezug bildet deine fachliche Grundlage

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT-Programm- und Projektmanagement mit und hast bereits erfolgreich IT-Großprojekte zum Abschluss geführt

Klassische sowie agile Skalierungsframeworks wie Nexus oder SAFe sind dir aus der praktischen Leitungserfahrung vertraut – idealerweise im Kontext großer Digitalisierungsvorhaben

Komplexe Stakeholder-Konstellationen steuerst du souverän und behältst dabei stets den Überblick über Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungsbedarfe

Analytisches, unternehmerisches Denken sowie eine ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung zeichnen deine Arbeitsweise aus

Du überzeugst durch sicheres Auftreten in Verhandlungen und Präsentationen auf allen Hierarchieebenen und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten

Auf Grund unserer flachen Hierarchien kannst du einen direkten Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg leisten
Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeiten sichern dir eine Work-Life-Balance
Daneben kannst du aus vielfältigen Varianten der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge wählen
Du wirst individuell in deinen Stärken gefördert – mit auf dich angepassten Weiterbildungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten
Zudem stehen dir folgende Sonderleistungen und Vergünstigungen zur Verfügung: Betriebsrestaurant
Betriebssportangebot
Deutschlandticket für die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel
Möglichkeiten der Kinderbetreuung

Du kannst an unseren umfangreichen Angeboten und Aktionen im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements teilnehmen

jobs.description:
Die FEPS GmbH ist ein dynamisch wachsendes, innovatives Unternehmen, das auf schlüsselfertige Modul- und Systembauweise in Holzrahmen-Technologie spezialisiert ist. Als Generalunternehmer verantworten wir den gesamten Zyklus von der integrierten BIM-Planung und der hochautomatisierten industriellen Fertigung in unseren modernen europäischen Partnerwerken bis hin zur schlüsselfertigen Montage, Errichtung und Inbetriebnahme vor Ort.
Um diese anspruchsvolle und hochkomplexe Aufgabe der standortübergreifenden Steuerung zu koordinieren, suchen wir eine unternehmerisch agierende, führungserfahrene und fachlich exzellent aufgestellte Persönlichkeit als Program Manager / Gesamtprojektleiter (m/w/d)
.
Auf einen Blick

Anstellungsart & Einstieg:
Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) | Ab sofort oder nach Absprache.
Standort & Mobilität:
Dienstsitz in unserem Headquarter in Martinsried sowie bedarfsgerechte Mobilität zu den verschiedenen Baustellen- und Projektstandorten in West-, Ost- und Süddeutschland.
Umfang & Projektvolumen:
Zentrale Gesamtverantwortung für ein schlüsselfertiges Modulbau-Großprogramm im öffentlichen Sektor mit einem geplanten Gesamtvolumen von bis zu ca. 1 Milliarde Euro.
Vergütung & Benefits:
Attraktives Brutto-Jahresgehalt von 90.000-120.000 € p.a., eine erfolgsorientierte Bonuskomponente, ein Premium-Dienstwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten und modernste IT-Ausstattung für mobiles Arbeiten.
Sicherheitsfreigabe:
Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜG) gemäß den Vorgaben für sensible Projekte im öffentlichen Sektor zwingend erforderlich | Einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis.

Aufgaben

Zentrale Programmsteuerung:
Gesamtverantwortung für die operative, vertragliche, terminliche und kaufmännische Umsetzung der beauftragten Regionallose des schlüsselfertigen Modulbau-Großprogramms.
Point of Contact (POC):
Wahrnehmung der Rolle des zentralen und alleinig bevollmächtigten Ansprechpartners gegenüber den öffentlichen Auftraggebern, Bauverwaltungen und übergeordneten Behörden.
Schnittstellen- & Partnermanagement:
Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Koordination aller beteiligten Fachplaner, unseres BIM-Gesamtkoordinators, unserer Modulwerke sowie der dezentralen Montage- und Ausführungspartner.
Ressourcen- & Kapazitätssteuerung:
Strategische Steuerung der standortübergreifenden Ressourcen zur sicheren Bewältigung der vertraglich geforderten jährlichen Abrufe und Sicherstellung einer kontinuierlichen Taktung.
Kosten- & Risikomanagement:
Etablierung eines lückenlosen Projektcontrollings, Aufbereitung von Leistungsänderungen (Nachtragsmanagement) sowie Steuerung proaktiver Risikominderungs- und Ersatzszenarien bei Ablaufstörungen.
Berichtswesen & Dokumentation:
Führung des qualifizierten Projekt- und Besprechungswesens, Erstellung monatlicher Fortschritts- und Leistungsberichte an den AG sowie Überwachung der rechtskonformen as-built-Bestandsdokumentation.

Profil

Ausbildung:
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen, Architektur, Projektmanagement (Bau) oder eine vergleichbare bautechnische akademische Ausbildung.
Berufserfahrung:
Mindestens 5–10 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung in der Gesamtprojektleitung von schlüsselfertigen Hochbauprojekten im industriellen Holzmodul-, System- oder Fertigteilbau.
Projekt- & Schnittstellensteuerung:
Nachweisbare Erfolge in der parallelen, standortübergreifenden Ressourcensteuerung sowie der logistischen Überwachung komplexer, internationaler Liefer- und Montageketten.
Regelwerks- & Prozesskenntnisse:
Sichere Kenntnisse in den Richtlinien für die Durchführung von Bauaufgaben des Bundes (RBBau), der VOB/B, der VOB/C sowie den gängigen baurechtlichen Verfahren in Deutschland.
BIM- & PM-Methodik:
Zertifizierung als Projektmanager nach anerkannten Standards (z. B. DVPzert, IPMA, PRINCE2) sowie tiefgehendes Verständnis digitaler, BIM-basierter Planungsprozesse (idealerweise DVPzert PM BIM).
Sprach- & Sozialkompetenz:
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C2) als vertragliche Kommunikationssprache sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse zur internen Abstimmung mit unseren europäischen Partnern; ausgeprägte Durchsetzungsstärke und Kommunikationsgeschick.
Sicherheitsprüfung:
Eignung und Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer behördlichen Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜG) gemäß den Vorgaben der öffentlichen Hand.

Wir bieten

Zukunftssicheres Arbeitsumfeld:
Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem expandierenden, hochinnovativen Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien und direkten Entscheidungswegen.
Attraktives Vergütungspaket:
Ein Jahresgehalt von 90.000-120.000 € p.a., ergänzt durch eine leistungsbezogene Bonuskomponente.
Erstklassige Mobilität:
Ein Premium-Firmenwagen (z. B. Audi, BMW, Mercedes) zur privaten Nutzung sowie modernste IT-Ausstattung (Laptop, Smartphone) für flexibles, mobiles Arbeiten.
Work-Life-Integration:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie großzügige Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten für administrative und strategische Projektschritte.
Sinnstiftende Projekte:
Die Steuerung eines der bedeutendsten modularen Bauprogramme in Deutschland mit messbarem Einfluss auf Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourceneffizienz.

nach einem Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit

jobs.title: Principal Project Manager | Australia
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

About The Role

Reporting to the Manager Experience Delivery, this role provides project management leadership for P&E initiatives, ensuring robust planning, governance, risk management, delivery coordination and reporting. The role drives disciplined project execution, manages dependencies and sequencing, and supports the achievement of strategic outcomes and benefits realisation.  

Accountabilities

Leads end-to-end project management for strategic P&E initiatives, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies and outcomes.  
Establishes and maintains integrated project plans, critical milestones, resource requirements and delivery schedules.  
Drives delivery governance, including project controls, stage gates, decision management and escalation processes.  
Identifies, assesses and manages project risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, ensuring timely mitigation and resolution.  
Coordinates cross-functional delivery across P&E teams, GBS HR, Technology, Finance, Governance and business stakeholders.  
Monitors project performance, delivery health and achievement of key milestones, proactively addressing delivery risks and constraints.  
Produces high-quality portfolio and project reporting, providing clear visibility of progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and delivery outcomes.  
Ensures projects align with P&E strategy, operating model principles, governance requirements and business objectives.  
Supports benefits realisation by establishing outcome measures, tracking benefits and facilitating post-implementation reviews.  
Contributes to the continuous improvement of project management methodologies, standards, tools, templates and delivery practices across P&E.  
Maintains oversight of inter-project dependencies and delivery sequencing to optimise resource utilisation and portfolio outcomes.  
Provides project management expertise, coaching and guidance to initiative leads and delivery teams to strengthen execution discipline and capability.  

About You

Tertiary qualification in project management, business, commerce, human resources or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Project management certification (such as PMP, PRINCE2 or AIPM) preferred
Proven experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs from initiation through to delivery and benefits realisation, ideally in a large, global organisation
Strong working knowledge of project governance, stage gates, risk and issue management, dependency and resource planning, and delivery reporting
Demonstrated ability to influence and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders, and to coach and guide delivery teams
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear, concise updates and decisions
Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools, including the Microsoft Office suite (Project, Excel and PowerPoint)

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.
Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.
Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.
Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.
Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.
Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.
Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.
Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.
Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.
Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.
Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.
Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.
Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.
Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

We're seeking someone to join our team as a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst in Technology to support technical threat investigations, track cyber adversaries, and produce actionable intelligence that strengthens detection, response, and risk-informed decision-making.

In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities.

What you'll do in the role:

> Conduct proactive threat research and investigative analysis to identify adversary campaigns, capabilities, infrastructure, targeting, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using internal collection, OSINT, and commercial intelligence sources.
> Research and track relevant threat actors, malware families, vulnerabilities, campaigns, and emerging threats, maintaining current knowledge of adversary behaviors and tradecraft.
> Triage cyber threat intelligence alerts and incoming intelligence, assessing relevance, credibility, severity, and potential impact, and escalating actionable findings as appropriate.
> Author clear, concise, and actionable threat intelligence reports, including tactical and technical reporting, threat assessments, investigative summaries, and intelligence briefings tailored to operational and non-technical audiences.
> Enrich, validate, and characterize threat indicators and technical artifacts using open-source, commercial, and internal security tooling, and curate high-confidence indicators of compromise (IOCs) for operational use.

> Maintain and update threat profiles aligned to assigned areas of responsibility and contribute intelligence that supports proactive detection and discovery.
> Contribute to the development and improvement of CTI analytic processes, investigative tradecraft, playbooks, and automation to improve the consistency and efficiency of intelligence workflows.
> Where applicable, use scripting and data analysis techniques, including Python, to support investigations, enrichment, data processing, and analytic workflows.

> Experience researching cyber threat actors, malware, campaigns, vulnerabilities, and adversary TTPs using internal, open-source, and/or commercial intelligence sources.
> Familiarity with intelligence analysis frameworks and methodologies such as MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, intelligence lifecycle, and structured analytic techniques.
> Experience conducting alert triage and investigative analysis, including evaluating intelligence for relevance, credibility, and potential organizational impact.
> Strong report writing and analytic communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate evidence, assessments, confidence levels, implications, and recommended actions.
> Understanding of intelligence requirements and collection management concepts, including identifying information gaps and aligning collection activity to priority intelligence needs.
> Familiarity with SIEM, endpoint, network, threat intelligence platform, or other security tooling and the ability to interpret relevant security telemetry in support of investigations.
> Experience enriching and analyzing indicators such as domains, IP addresses, URLs, file hashes, malware artifacts, and related technical infrastructure.
> Working knowledge of scripting or data analysis, preferably Python, for automation, enrichment, or investigative workflows.
> Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources, distinguish fact from assessment, and develop evidence-based analytic judgments.
> Ability to work collaboratively across cybersecurity teams and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
> Ability to manage multiple investigative and intelligence priorities while maintaining attention to detail and producing timely, high-quality analysis.

Nice to have:

> Experience with threat intelligence platforms, commercial intelligence providers, OSINT tooling, malware analysis platforms, or large-scale security data analysis.
> Familiarity with intelligence requirements management, source evaluation, structured analytic techniques, or intelligence production standards.

jobs.description:
Summary

This role is dedicated to analyzing cyber threats through the lens of specific industry sectors, delivering context-rich threat intelligence that aligns technical findings with sector technologies, processes, regulations, and business impact.

Job Description

The analyst translates complex technical intelligence—including eCrime and APT activity—into actionable security and risk insights, sector-relevant risk narratives, and executive-aligned guidance, empowering customers to make informed decisions for their industry environment. They own the end-to-end creation of industry-focused threat intelligence reports, synthesizing internal telemetry, finished intelligence, and OSINT to provide comprehensive, sector-specific assessments.

Meet the Team

ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

About The Role

Industry-focused threat intelligence

Identify, track and document APT and eCrime actors that are relevant and active in the given sectors. Analyze cyber threats, attacker behavior, campaigns, and trends as they specifically impact these sectors.
Assess vulnerabilities, technologies, and architectures commonly used in the sector and their exposure to current threats.

Intelligence collection

Continuously monitor OSINT sources, including:
Security research and vulnerability disclosures affecting sector-relevant technology stacks
Publications from sector organizations, government entities, and regulators
Broader industry trends, geopolitical factors, and other developments impacting cyber risk
Collaborate closely with in-house Threat Intelligence teams to understand current technical findings, campaigns, and telemetry-based observations.
Work with strategic/geopolitical analysts to integrate broader context into sector threat assessments.

Intelligence reporting and analysis

Produce regular industry-focused intelligence reports combining curated and contextualized OSINT in addition to our proprietary intelligence, derived from ESET telemetry and internal research.
Move beyond isolated cases by identifying, documenting, and explaining sector-specific trends and patterns.
Clearly articulate operational and business impact relevant to the industry audience.

Other Responsibilities

Act as a subject-matter expert for internal teams, including sales, customer success, and marketing, providing sector-specific threat context. Serve as a bridge between technical Threat Intelligence analysts and customer-facing or business teams. Support sector-specific positioning of Threat Intelligence offerings.
Deliver threat intelligence briefings to existing and prospective customers within the assigned sectors.
Represent the company at industry-focused cybersecurity conferences and events.

Essential Requirements

Possess a strong background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or cybersecurity operations, and demonstrate the ability to analyze cyber threats beyond purely technical indicators.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Demonstrated ability to produce concise, actionable reports that clearly communicate research findings and recommendations, ensuring relevance and impact for industry stakeholders.
Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to present complex threat intelligence also to non-technical/executive audiences.

Desirable Requirements

Prior experience working within a specific industry sector, preferably as threat intelligence analyst, SOC analyst, internal security professional or similar role.
Understanding of regulatory and compliance environments relevant to critical industries (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001).
Experience presenting at conferences or delivering customer briefings.

Primary Purpose

CNA is hiring for Research Analysts
to join their Regional, Strategy and Policy Analysis (RSP) Division. RSP provides senior national security decision-makers with regional and global analysis that links strategy, policy, and operations. RSP is hiring for Research Analysts to join their research programs below:

Ally and Partner Security Affairs program (APA)

APA strengthens US warfighting readiness and advances mutual security objectives through analyses of foreign government strategies, operations, and capabilities. Our team integrates language-capable regional specialists, expertise on foreign military systems, and functional assessments on issues such as security cooperation. Our core lines of work include analyses on: (1) coalition warfare, (2) alliance management, (3) security assistance, (4) overseas posture, and (5) global commons. APA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, which include: allied navies and joint forces; strategic laydown, dispersal, and posture; and regional expertise on NATO and the Indian Ocean region.

Countering Threats and Challenges Program (CTC)

CTC advances the Department of War’s ability to anticipate, design, and adapt to the evolving character of conflict. CTC integrates expertise in future conflict, force design, asymmetric warfare, and adversary dynamics to enable the joint force and its partners to outpace threats, optimize roles and missions, and drive operational advantage in complex and contested environments. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: 1) force design; 2) net assessment and comparative military analysis; 3) asymmetric warfare; 4) Russia studies; 5) future operating environment and technological adaptation. We welcome candidates who are passionate about shaping the future of military operations.

Strategy and Policy Analysis Program (SPA)

SPA helps U.S. government leaders understand national security and defense strategy challenges and analyze their options to address them. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: (1) strategic and nuclear deterrence; (2) national and regional defense strategy, plans, policies, and posture; (4) emerging technology integration into military strategy; and (4) Joint Force and naval campaigning in regions such as the Indian Ocean, Arctic, the Caribbean and Latin America, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. SPA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, including but not limited to: US military strategy, military campaign planning and analysis, nuclear deterrence, missile defense, emerging military technologies, and Iranian military strategy and capabilities

CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Our flexible and engaging work environment encourages iterative and creative collaboration at every stage of the problem solving process. Our employees are committed to helping clients develop effective solutions to better manage their programs through scientific, data-driven approaches. We are looking for creative and innovative individuals to help carry out our mission.

Job Description And/Or Duties

Contributes productively and harmoniously to the work of others; treats everyone respectfully, professionally and fairly. Keeps others informed. Proactively identifies and seeks out others working on similar topics. Works to identify opportunities for collaborations within team, division, and operating unit.

CNA offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, and a 403(b) retirement plan with employer matching.
