new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Construction
new_jobs.description:
About the Organization

Colovore is the leader in ultra-high-density, liquid-cooled AI colocation data centers for the deployment of AI inference, SuperPod, and AI factory applications and solutions. With facilities featuring power densities of 17-500+ kilowatts per cabinet, we are expanding quickly and building a national footprint of modern, hyper-efficient, high-density data centers to serve F500 enterprises and startups. The company was acquired by King Street in 2024, who provides real estate development expertise and secured $925 million funding to accelerate its national expansion. Join our team and play a critical role as we scale for rapid growth. You can be a game-changer at Colovore.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Project Manager, Construction to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Colovore’s high-density data center development projects. This role manages construction activities from pre-construction through commissioning, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and safety. The ideal candidate brings strong technical knowledge of construction and commissioning processes, especially MEP and mission-critical systems—combined with excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. You will serve as a key liaison between internal teams, contractors, and design partners to support the successful delivery of complex, fast-paced projects.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

Manage day-to-day project delivery from construction start through turnover.
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, identifying critical paths and mitigating risks proactively.
Track progress, resolve issues, and drive alignment across contractors, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders.
Lead coordination of site logistics, permitting, inspections, and construction readiness.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cost Control

Monitor project budgets, commitments, forecasts, and cost-to-complete reports.
Review and validate change orders, pay applications, and vendor invoices.
Partner closely with Development Finance and Preconstruction to ensure accurate financial reporting and cost alignment.

Contractor & Vendor Management

Serve as primary point of contact for general contractors, subcontractors, and third-party vendors.
Lead weekly coordination meetings, track deliverables, and enforce performance expectations.
Ensure all partners adhere to project schedules, quality standards, and safety protocols.

Design Coordination

Collaborate with architects, engineers, and internal technical stakeholders to review drawings, specifications, RFIs, and submittals.
Facilitate resolution of design conflicts and ensure constructability alignment.
Support value engineering efforts to optimize cost, performance, and schedule.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

Conduct site walks to monitor workmanship, safety practices, installation quality, and design adherence.
Ensure compliance with codes, regulations, and company standards.
Support commissioning activities, testing, and system handover documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Development, Engineering, Operations, and Procurement to support project readiness and seamless handoff.
Communicate project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership with clarity and transparency.
Coordinate with Operations to ensure systems and documentation are ready for activation and ongoing management.

Documentation & Reporting

Maintain accurate project logs, reports, meeting minutes, submittal trackers, and decision records.
Prepare updates and dashboards for leadership on schedule, risks, costs, and milestones.
Ensure all documentation required for commissioning and closeout is complete and organized.

Key Skills

Strong understanding of construction sequencing, scheduling, and project controls.
Deep knowledge of MEP systems, mission-critical infrastructure, or technical building programs.
Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Skilled at reading and interpreting drawings, specifications, and submittals.
Strong communication and relationship management abilities.
Proven ability to lead contractors and cross-functional teams through complex challenges.
High attention to detail and organizational skills in documentation and reporting.
Effective risk management and problem-solving instincts.
Proficiency with construction management tools and scheduling software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, MS Project/P6, ACC, Yardi).
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving needs.

Required Experience

7–10+ years of construction project management experience, ideally with large commercial, industrial, and a minimum of 4+ years directly in mission-critical builds.
Demonstrated experience managing general contractors, subcontractors, and technical project scopes.
Strong background in MEP-heavy construction, infrastructure systems, or high-density facilities.
Proven ability to manage schedules, budgets, RFIs, submittals, and site coordination.
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering (Elec/Mech/Eng. Mgmt. Preferred), Architecture, or equivalent related field experience.

What Success Looks Like

Projects delivered on time, under budget, and with exceptional quality.
Strong coordination between contractors, designers, and internal teams.
Clear, proactive communication that keeps stakeholders informed and aligned.
Minimal change orders due to strong upfront coordination and oversight.
Safety, documentation, and compliance consistently meeting or exceeding standards.
Smooth handoff to Operations with complete turnover packages and fully commissioned systems.
Continuous improvements implemented to streamline future builds.

Why You’ll Love Working at Colovore

At Colovore, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered. We offer a competitive and thoughtful benefits package designed to support your health, growth, and life outside of work, including:

Competitive compensation
with opportunities for growth and advancement
Comprehensive health benefits
(medical, dental, and vision)
Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
to support flexibility, rest, and work-life balance
10 paid company holidays
and paid sick leave
401(k) plan
with company participation
Professional development opportunities
and learning support
Collaborative, inclusive culture
where your work makes a real impact

If you’re excited to build meaningful infrastructure, solve complex challenges, and grow with a team that values both performance and people, we’d love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About Our Organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe Has Three Interconnected Extensibility Primitives

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.

Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

Background in product management or product operations
Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $157,700 - $236,500. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About Our Organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe Has Three Interconnected Extensibility Primitives

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.

Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

Background in product management or product operations
Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $157,700 - $236,500. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

.

Own end-to-end delivery of assigned programs of moderate complexity through planning, execution, launch readiness, and closeout.

Apply lessons learned, propose improvements to program management and NPD practices, and help drive adoption across the PgM team and supported business areas.

PMP, PgMP, or related certification with demonstrated practical application.
Experience working with global teams, international suppliers, or distributed development and manufacturing organizations.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Brings structure to ambiguous cross-functional work and challenges unclear assumptions.
Builds program plans based on scope, assumptions, dependencies, trade-offs, critical path, and risk.
Connects program decisions to schedule, cost, quality, operational readiness, portfolio priorities, and customer outcomes.
Understands product development at a systems level and identifies when technical decisions affect program delivery.

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About The Role

We're looking for a GTM Project Manager to help bring IXOPAY's payment technology products and capabilities to market.

In this cross-functional role, you'll coordinate product launches and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring new capabilities are introduced with clear messaging, aligned teams, effective enablement, and measurable outcomes. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Client Success, you'll help turn product development into successful launches that drive customer adoption and business growth.

You'll take ownership of launch planning and execution, coordinate internal readiness, develop enablement materials, and track adoption and performance after release. You'll also help strengthen the processes, reporting, and collaboration that connect Product development with our commercial teams.

This is an opportunity to combine strong program management and communication skills with product strategy and go-to-market execution, helping shape how IXOPAY introduces innovative payment solutions to enterprise customers around the world.

What You'll Do

Drive Product Launches & GTM Readiness

Plan, coordinate, and execute go-to-market activities for new products, features, and capabilities using IXOPAY's product launch framework.
Own launch timelines, readiness checklists, deliverables, and cross-functional coordination from planning through go-live and post-launch review.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Client Success, and Partnerships to align priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure teams are prepared for launch.

Enable Sales, Solutions & Customer-Facing Teams

Gather feedback from commercial teams to identify enablement gaps and opportunities to improve product understanding.

Coordinate Strategic Product Initiatives

Coordinate deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder communication to keep initiatives progressing toward defined outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve product-to-GTM handoffs, launch processes, and cross-functional collaboration.
Support Product team operations, including planning meetings and workshops, maintaining documentation, and coordinating vendor-related activities.
Develop repeatable workflows and processes that improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across product initiatives.

Track Product Adoption & GTM Performance

Establish and maintain reporting that tracks product launches, adoption, enablement effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
Develop dashboards and regular updates that provide Product and GTM leadership with visibility into launch progress and outcomes.
Gather post-launch feedback from Sales, Client Success, customers, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement.
Partner with Product leadership to evaluate launch effectiveness, adoption trends, and opportunities to strengthen future GTM initiatives.
Use data and insights to continuously improve launch execution, enablement, and product adoption strategies.

What You'll Bring

Required

Experience in Project Management, Product Go-to-Market, Product Operations, Product Marketing, Program Management, Project Management, or a related role within a B2B SaaS or technology organization.
Proven experience coordinating cross-functional product launches or go-to-market initiatives from planning through execution and post-launch evaluation.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and competing deadlines.
Experience working collaboratively with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and customer-facing teams.
Ability to translate technical product information into clear, compelling, and practical communication and enablement materials.
Experience developing launch plans, tracking deliverables, managing dependencies, and identifying risks.
Strong analytical skills and experience using data to track performance, adoption, and operational effectiveness.
Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, spreadsheets, and reporting or business intelligence platforms.
Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and modern software development processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across distributed, cross-functional teams.
Professional fluency in English, including the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across the United States and Europe.

Preferred

Experience in payments, FinTech, financial infrastructure, or another complex B2B technology environment.
Experience bringing API-first, developer-focused, or enterprise SaaS products to market.
Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, payment processing, or related technologies.
Experience developing product enablement programs or supporting technical product launches.
Experience working with product adoption metrics, launch performance reporting, and customer feedback.
Experience supporting Agile product teams or coordinating software delivery initiatives.
Experience working across US and European teams and time zones.
Relevant certifications such as CSM, PSM, CAPM, PMP, or Pragmatic Institute.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help bring innovative payment technology to market, connecting product development with the teams and customers who rely on our solutions.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Marketing, and commercial strategy, helping introduce new capabilities across payment orchestration, tokenization, AI Payments Intelligence, and emerging payment technologies.

You'll have meaningful ownership of product launch initiatives, opportunities to improve how we bring products to market, and the ability to influence adoption and customer success across a global organization.

For US-based Employees, We Offer

Competitive compensation
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA)

Location

Nextpower is a leading provider of advanced single-axis solar tracking systems. Our solutions help solar power plants increase energy production and operate reliably. We’re committed to advancing the global transition to renewable energy through technology, engineering, and operational excellence.

Nextpower is seeking an experienced Staff Engineering Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional engineering programs from early concept through production and deployment. You’ll connect product goals with engineering execution, build alignment across teams, and help resolve the technical, operational, and business challenges that shape program outcomes.

This role calls for a leader who can guide complex programs across engineering, manufacturing, product management, and supply chain; communicate clearly with senior stakeholders; and improve how teams plan and deliver work.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex engineering programs from concept through design, validation, production readiness, and launch, aligning scope and priorities with company goals.
Translate product and business objectives into integrated program plans, milestones, resource needs, and delivery commitments.
Establish program governance, decision processes, and communication rhythms that keep cross-functional teams aligned.
Coordinate work across engineering, manufacturing, product management, supply chain, and other partner teams.
Track progress, dependencies, budgets, and schedule risks; identify issues early and drive them to resolution.
Lead cross-functional reviews and support timely decisions on scope, tradeoffs, technical risks, and resource constraints.

Build strong working relationships across teams and help resolve disagreements constructively.
Capture lessons learned and improve program management practices, tools, and processes.

10 or more years of experience in engineering program management, preferably in renewable energy, solar, or another hardware-focused industry.

Experience building and managing integrated schedules, budgets, dependencies, risks, and program plans.
Proficiency with project and program management tools.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and technical teams.
Sound judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make progress amid uncertainty and competing priorities.

Summary

You will serve as an IT PROGRAM MANAGER in the Command Information Office of Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command.

Duties

You will serve as the program lead for a significant program with Command-wide or enterprise-wide impact.You will perform program management including analyzing and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data to support strategic decision making.You will lead IT and data project teams in a visionary, customer-focused manner, managing hardware, software, data pipelines, APIs, systems, services, engineering, integration, and documentation activities.You will lead the strategic exploration, adoption, and governance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) capabilities across the enterprise data ecosystem.You will establish robust AI governance protocols to ensure all implementations comply with GenAI.mil guidelines, DOW directives, and rigorous Unbiased AI Principles.You will serve as the Command's technical authority on data integration, interoperability, and enterprise data flow.You will design, implement, and manage comprehensive data integration strategies that bridge legacy operational technology (OT) systems with modern, cloud-based data lakehouse architectures.You will employ expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to assess and improve complex management processes, IT systems, and data flow architectures.

Qualifications

Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1. Enterprise Data Management and Architecture: Expertise in managing complex NAVFAC SYSCOM data environments, including integration of legacy operational data, enterprise networks, data Lakehouse platforms, API-based data exchange, and cloud data services. Knowledge of data architecture, data lifecycle management, and scalable data integration practices. Strong interpersonal skills to build consensus among diverse stakeholders (technical vendors, DBAs, data stewards, and other Naval activities), resolve critical integration bottlenecks, and provide subject matter expertise. 2. Data Governance and Data Quality: Advanced capability in applying project management principles (cost, schedule, resources, POA&M, AOA) to short- and long-range IT/data acquisitions. Ability to establish and administer enterprise data governance frameworks, including data standards, metadata management, data stewardship, schema governance, data quality controls, and repeatable standard operating procedures. Skilled in assessing data processes and implementing improvements that enhance data completeness, consistency, accessibility, accuracy, and usability. 3. Master Data Management and Data Engineering: Proficiency in developing and sustaining master data management (MDM) capabilities, including authoritative data sources, data domains, reference data, data lineage, data reconciliation, and cross-system integration. Ability to apply data engineering principles to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models, curated data sets, and analytics-ready data products. and 4. AI Development and Data Enablement: Experience supporting the development and implementation of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities, including generative AI and large language model applications. Ability to prepare, govern, validate, and maintain high-quality data assets that enable responsible, reliable, and mission-relevant AI development across NAVFAC SYSCOM. To include knowledge with the latest in dashboard visualization tools in industry. Your experience must reflect skill in the following areas: attention to detail, customer service, oral communication, and problem solving. Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/ Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Additional Information

This position is covered by the Department of Defense Priority Placement Program. Additional vacancies may be filled by this announcement. A tentative offer of employment will be rescinded if the selectee fails to meet the pre-employment requirements, including failure to report to any of the scheduled appointments. During the application process you will have the ability to opt-in to make your resume available to hiring managers in the agency who have similar positions in the local commuting area. Depending on the hiring organization and the position being filled, job requirements (e.g., security clearance, travel, drug testing, financial disclosure filing, bargaining unit status, etc.) may vary. Other hiring managers filling similar positions may offer relocation expense reimbursement and/or may offer recruitment incentives for new employees, depending on funding availability and in accordance with policy. If you opt-in and are referred on a certificate, your resume will be available to other hiring managers for 180-days from the date the job announcement closes. Opting in does not impact your application for this announcement, nor does it guarantee further consideration for additional positions. Federal annuitant information: The selection of an annuitant is subject to the Department of Defense and Department of the Navy policy on the employment of annuitants. Policy information may be found at: http://www.secnav.navy.mil/donhr/Documents/CivilianJobs/FedCivAnnuitants.pdf PPP applicants will be placed at the FPL, if determined Well Qualified (WQ). To receive priority consideration, the FPL must be the same grade level or equivalent of the retained grade or the grade held immediately prior to separation. In addition to meeting all minimum qualification and eligibility requirements, ICTAP applicants must be well qualified for the position to receive consideration for special priority selection. A well-qualified ICTAP applicant is one who possesses the competencies and experience to perform the duties of the position successfully with orientation to learn/understand the activities, procedures, policies and processes. Demonstrated work experience in the occupation is typically qualifying for placement. This criterion cannot be met by education and training. ICTAP candidates must provide copies of all of the following documentation at the time of application: 1) agency notice; 2) most recent performance appraisal and 3) most recent SF-50 or notification of personnel action that includes position, grade level, and duty location. Applicants who do not provide this documentation will not receive consideration as an ICTAP candidate. For more information about ICTAP eligibility please review the following link: https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiring-paths/federal-employees/career-transition/ Military Spouse Preference applicants will be placed at the highest grade for which they have applied and are determined Best Qualified (BQ). A BQ military spouse possesses knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies comparable to others who meet the competitive referral criteria for the specific position.

new_jobs.description:
Eaton’s Corporate Sector division is currently seeking a IT Growth Site Deployments Program Manager. This position offers a hybrid work schedule and may be based in Arden, NC; El Paso, TX; Greenwood, SC; Raleigh, NC; Beachwood, OH; or Sumter, SC.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $130000 - $190000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Growth Site Deployments Program Manager to lead technology and digital deployments across Eaton’s Key Strategic Growth (KSG) sites. This role translates business priorities and capability roadmaps into integrated site deployment plans from readiness through cutover and stabilization.

The Program Manager will coordinate across site leadership, Continuous Improvement (CI), Digital and IT, Operations, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, solution teams, BRMs, and external partners. This role owns deployment execution, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, and governance.

This individual contributor will drive adoption, solve delivery challenges, and establish repeatable deployment practices that can scale across sites. Travel up to 25% is required based on deployment needs.

What You’ll Do

Lead complex technology and digital deployments across assigned KSG manufacturing sites from planning through stabilization.
Own integrated deployment plans, including scope, milestones, resources, budget, risks, dependencies, readiness, cutover, and sustainment.
Translate approved roadmaps and capability plans into actionable site-level deployment plans with clear ownership and outcomes.
Partner with CI, Digital and IT, Operations, site leadership, BRMs, and capability teams to coordinate execution and align commitments
Assess readiness across people, process, data, infrastructure, technology, training, and support; identify barriers and drive resolution.
Manage program funding, forecasts, resources, vendors, risks, issues, and dependencies while providing clear leadership reporting.
Track deployment outcomes, adoption, and operational performance in partnership with site and business owners.
Ensure deployments align with architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise standards while creating repeatable practices that can scale across sites.
Apply Lean and continuous improvement methods to simplify delivery and resolve issues at the source.
Use data, automation, and approved AI tools to improve planning, analysis, risk identification, decision-making, and reporting. Expected Outcomes and Success Measures
Deployments achieve defined scope, schedule, budget, adoption, and business objectives.
Sites demonstrate readiness and sustained adoption of deployed capabilities.
Risks, dependencies, and resource constraints are identified and addressed early.
Deployment practices are standardized and scalable across prioritized sites.
Program performance, financials, risks, and outcomes are clearly communicated to business and IT leadership.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 7 years of experience leading moderate to highly complex technology projects or programs.
Minimum of 3 years of experience managing integrated project or program plans that include schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and resources.
Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering technology or digital capabilities within manufacturing, industrial, operations, or similarly complex operating environments.
Minimum of 2 years of experience coordinating multi-site deployments or the deployment of repeatable technology solutions across multiple locations.
Must currently reside within a 50-mile radius of Arden, NC; El Paso, TX; Greenwood, SC; Raleigh, NC; Beachwood, OH; or Sumter, SC.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.
Must be able and willing to travel up to 25% to assigned manufacturing and business sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering technology or digital capabilities within manufacturing or operations environments.
Experience scaling proven technology or digital solutions across multiple manufacturing sites.
Working knowledge of enterprise applications, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, integrations, and operational support dependencies.
Strong knowledge of program management principles, methodologies, and tools.
Experience managing program funding, forecasts, resource plans, and vendor commitments.
Experience partnering across IT, Digital, Operations, Continuous Improvement, site leadership, and other matrixed functions.
Continuous improvement experience using methodologies such as A3, DMAIC, value-stream mapping, Lean/EBS, or root-cause problem solving.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or comparable continuous improvement certification.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, or comparable project/program management certification.
Experience using modern AI productivity tools to accelerate analysis, planning, documentation, and delivery.
Experience supporting technology deployments involving enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure, and integration requirements.

Skills

Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical information into clear business terms.
Ability to organize complex work already in motion and make thoughtful adjustments that accelerate outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, establish accountability, and coordinate cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization.
Strong judgment, structured problem-solving, conflict resolution, and a pragmatic, results-driven approach.
Business and financial acumen with an understanding of how technology deployments affect safety, quality, capacity, speed, customer commitments, and growth.
Continuous improvement and digital mindset with a willingness to engage directly with site and frontline teams, understand work at the point of execution, resolve issues at the source, and create repeatable solutions.
Ability to use data, digital capabilities, automation, and approved AI tools responsibly to improve execution and decision-making.
Ability to work effectively across diverse, global teams, cultures, and organizations.

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Come and be a part of this success.

About The Role

Reporting to the Manager Experience Delivery, this role provides project management leadership for P&E initiatives, ensuring robust planning, governance, risk management, delivery coordination and reporting. The role drives disciplined project execution, manages dependencies and sequencing, and supports the achievement of strategic outcomes and benefits realisation.

Leads end-to-end project management for strategic P&E initiatives, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies and outcomes.  
Establishes and maintains integrated project plans, critical milestones, resource requirements and delivery schedules.  
Drives delivery governance, including project controls, stage gates, decision management and escalation processes.  
Identifies, assesses and manages project risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, ensuring timely mitigation and resolution.  
Coordinates cross-functional delivery across P&E teams, GBS HR, Technology, Finance, Governance and business stakeholders.  
Monitors project performance, delivery health and achievement of key milestones, proactively addressing delivery risks and constraints.  
Produces high-quality portfolio and project reporting, providing clear visibility of progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and delivery outcomes.  
Ensures projects align with P&E strategy, operating model principles, governance requirements and business objectives.  
Supports benefits realisation by establishing outcome measures, tracking benefits and facilitating post-implementation reviews.  
Contributes to the continuous improvement of project management methodologies, standards, tools, templates and delivery practices across P&E.  
Maintains oversight of inter-project dependencies and delivery sequencing to optimise resource utilisation and portfolio outcomes.  
Provides project management expertise, coaching and guidance to initiative leads and delivery teams to strengthen execution discipline and capability.  

About You

Tertiary qualification in project management, business, commerce, human resources or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Project management certification (such as PMP, PRINCE2 or AIPM) preferred
Proven experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs from initiation through to delivery and benefits realisation, ideally in a large, global organisation
Strong working knowledge of project governance, stage gates, risk and issue management, dependency and resource planning, and delivery reporting
Demonstrated ability to influence and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders, and to coach and guide delivery teams
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear, concise updates and decisions
Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools, including the Microsoft Office suite (Project, Excel and PowerPoint)
Experience delivering HR, people or operating model change initiatives is preferred but not essential

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks.

If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal.

Supporting a Diverse Workforce

The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms. 

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. Enterprise Deployment Management

Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and escalation leadership skills.
Ability to build structure in ambiguous environments and translate strategy into measurable execution plans.

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.
Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.
Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.
Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.
Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.
Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.
Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.
Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.
Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.
Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.
Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.
Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.
Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.
Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Summary

This role is dedicated to analyzing cyber threats through the lens of specific industry sectors, delivering context-rich threat intelligence that aligns technical findings with sector technologies, processes, regulations, and business impact.

Job Description

The analyst translates complex technical intelligence—including eCrime and APT activity—into actionable security and risk insights, sector-relevant risk narratives, and executive-aligned guidance, empowering customers to make informed decisions for their industry environment. They own the end-to-end creation of industry-focused threat intelligence reports, synthesizing internal telemetry, finished intelligence, and OSINT to provide comprehensive, sector-specific assessments.

Meet the Team

ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

About The Role

Industry-focused threat intelligence

Identify, track and document APT and eCrime actors that are relevant and active in the given sectors. Analyze cyber threats, attacker behavior, campaigns, and trends as they specifically impact these sectors.
Assess vulnerabilities, technologies, and architectures commonly used in the sector and their exposure to current threats.

Intelligence collection

Continuously monitor OSINT sources, including:
Security research and vulnerability disclosures affecting sector-relevant technology stacks
Publications from sector organizations, government entities, and regulators
Broader industry trends, geopolitical factors, and other developments impacting cyber risk
Collaborate closely with in-house Threat Intelligence teams to understand current technical findings, campaigns, and telemetry-based observations.
Work with strategic/geopolitical analysts to integrate broader context into sector threat assessments.

Intelligence reporting and analysis

Produce regular industry-focused intelligence reports combining curated and contextualized OSINT in addition to our proprietary intelligence, derived from ESET telemetry and internal research.
Move beyond isolated cases by identifying, documenting, and explaining sector-specific trends and patterns.

Risk & Performance Management Department

In Risk & Performance Management Department (RPMD), we work collaboratively across teams to identify and address potential blind spots, ensuring that all relevant risks are considered and duly addressed.

Operational Risk Management

The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team is responsible for driving and managing the corporate operational risk management programme within GIC. Operational risk tools and analytics are developed to better inform management about the operational risk landscape. We are looking for a dynamic and self-motivated individual to join the team as an Assistant Vice President/ Vice President, focusing on data analytics to strengthen risk and control oversight.

What impact can you make in this role?

You will be part of a team responsible for the independent assessment, measurement, monitoring and reporting of GIC's operational risk profile. You will bring a data-driven approach across the team's mandate, using analytics and AI/LLM tools to evaluate controls, support third-party and outsourcing risk assessments, generate insights, and strengthen the firm's overall risk and control environment.

What will you do as an AVP/VP in ORM?
Develop and maintain dashboards and data analytics capability to meet the team's risk analysis, monitoring and reporting needs
Analyse and interpret large data sets to identify risks, control gaps, trends and thematic issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Apply data analytics to enhance control assurance and testing (e.g. automating test procedures, running full-population testing on raw transactional data in place of sampling, and identifying control exceptions and anomalies)
Support third-party and outsourcing due diligence and risk assessments with data-driven analysis (e.g. vendor risk data, concentration analysis, and identification of emerging risks)
Leverage AI/LLM tools to augment risk and control workflows (e.g. reviewing documentation, extracting and summarising key information from contracts and reports, comparing responses against policy requirements to flag gaps, and generating first-cut insights for reviewer refinement)
Track, collate and report key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) across the team's remit, and analyse trends to flag emerging risks and control weaknesses
Monitor and report risk and control outcomes to senior management and GIC's risk governance committees
Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of methodologies, frameworks and supporting tools, including embedding AI/analytics into assessment workflows
Work with risk managers and business stakeholders to embed a rigorous, data-driven approach across the team's activities

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?

Must-haves: At least 5 (AVP) and 7 (VP) years' experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related field
Strong / advanced proficiency in data mining, analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau), and programming languages such as Python and SQL
Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to analytics or risk work (e.g. document review, summarisation, gap analysis, and workflow automation)

Good to have: Experience in control assurance, control testing, or a related assurance discipline, including familiarity with control frameworks and testing methodologies
Experience in third-party risk management, vendor due diligence or outsourcing risk, including familiarity with due diligence methodologies and risk assessment frameworks
Broader domain knowledge in operational risk, audit or a related risk and controls field

Attributes: Intellectually curious, with a passion for using data and AI to connect the dots and generate insights that translate into value for stakeholders
Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to synthesise diverse information into clear conclusions
Adept at presenting findings in strong, digestible visuals
Forward-thinking and keen to stay current with developments in the risk, analytics and AI space
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across business areas and seniority levels
Strong organisational and project management skills

Primary Purpose

CNA is hiring for Research Analysts
to join their Regional, Strategy and Policy Analysis (RSP) Division. RSP provides senior national security decision-makers with regional and global analysis that links strategy, policy, and operations. RSP is hiring for Research Analysts to join their research programs below:

Ally and Partner Security Affairs program (APA)

APA strengthens US warfighting readiness and advances mutual security objectives through analyses of foreign government strategies, operations, and capabilities. Our team integrates language-capable regional specialists, expertise on foreign military systems, and functional assessments on issues such as security cooperation. Our core lines of work include analyses on: (1) coalition warfare, (2) alliance management, (3) security assistance, (4) overseas posture, and (5) global commons. APA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, which include: allied navies and joint forces; strategic laydown, dispersal, and posture; and regional expertise on NATO and the Indian Ocean region.

Countering Threats and Challenges Program (CTC)

CTC advances the Department of War’s ability to anticipate, design, and adapt to the evolving character of conflict. CTC integrates expertise in future conflict, force design, asymmetric warfare, and adversary dynamics to enable the joint force and its partners to outpace threats, optimize roles and missions, and drive operational advantage in complex and contested environments. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: 1) force design; 2) net assessment and comparative military analysis; 3) asymmetric warfare; 4) Russia studies; 5) future operating environment and technological adaptation. We welcome candidates who are passionate about shaping the future of military operations.

Strategy and Policy Analysis Program (SPA)

SPA helps U.S. government leaders understand national security and defense strategy challenges and analyze their options to address them. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: (1) strategic and nuclear deterrence; (2) national and regional defense strategy, plans, policies, and posture; (4) emerging technology integration into military strategy; and (4) Joint Force and naval campaigning in regions such as the Indian Ocean, Arctic, the Caribbean and Latin America, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. SPA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, including but not limited to: US military strategy, military campaign planning and analysis, nuclear deterrence, missile defense, emerging military technologies, and Iranian military strategy and capabilities

new_jobs.title: Beleidsadviseur/project manager Strategy & International Relations (ADSB, 32-40 uur)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging binnen een dynamische, internationale omgeving waar politiek, bedrijfsleven en financiële wereld elkaar ontmoeten? Atradius Dutch State Business zoekt voor het team Strategy & International Relations een analytische en verbindende beleidsadviseur/projectmanager. In deze functie combineer je inhoudelijke beleidsontwikkeling met stevig projectmanagement en werk je aan nationale en internationale vraagstukken die direct relevant zijn voor de Nederlandse exportsector.

Over Atradius Dutch State Business

Atradius DSB, onderdeel van de Atradius groep, voert de exportkredietverzekeringsfaciliteit (ekv) uit en biedt namens de Nederlandse staat verzekerings- en garantieproducten aan voor betalingsrisico’s bij zakendoen in het buitenland. Onze klanten zijn Nederlandse exporteurs van kapitaalgoederen of diensten, investeerders, aannemingsbedrijven en hun financiers. Naast traditionele export ondersteunen we ook de bredere internationalisatie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven met onze producten.

Je werkt in het team Strategy & International Relations. Dit multidisciplinaire team stuurt het strategieproces aan op basis van nationale prioriteiten en internationale ontwikkelingen, adviseert de Nederlandse staat bij EU- en OESO-onderhandelingen en onderhoudt relaties met onder meer andere exportkredietverzekeraars en de Berner Unie (een internationaal netwerk van verzekeraars). We werken nauw samen met onze opdrachtgevers, de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken, en met collega’s binnen Atradius DSB aan strategische beleidsvraagstukken.

Wat ga je doen?

In deze mediorfunctie ontwikkel en implementeer je beleid op het snijvlak van publieke belangen, internationale economische vraagstukken en de uitvoering van de ekv. Hierbij combineer je projectmanagement met een inhoudelijke bijdrage. Je stuurt het proces aan, verdiept je in de dossiers en brengt de kennis en inzichten van collega’s en betrokken partijen samen. Daarbij analyseer je belangen en ontwikkelingen, vorm je een onderbouwd oordeel en vertaal je dit samen met collega’s naar concrete beleidsvoorstellen en uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Je trekt zelfstandig beleidsprojecten van begin tot eind. Dit zijn je belangrijkste taken:

Projectmanagement: je stelt een aanpak en planning op, coördineert multidisciplinaire projectteams, bewaakt voortgang en kwaliteit, rapporteert over resultaten en zorgt voor tijdige besluitvorming en implementatie.
Nationale beleidscoördinatie: je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van het Nederlandse beleid voor de ekv in samenwerking met de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken en collega’s. Op specifieke dossiers coördineer je de afstemming en werk je beleidsvoorstellen uit, met oog voor de belangen van onder meer exporteurs en financiers. Je werkt aan beleidsontwikkeling en executie van strategische onderwerpen zoals transparantie, anti-fraude, vergroening en andere prioritaire vraagstukken binnen de ekv. Afhankelijk van de agenda pak je in overleg zelfstandig nieuwe thema’s op.
Internationale dossiers: je ondersteunt senior adviseurs bij de voorbereiding en opvolging van internationale overleggen binnen bestaande gremia zoals de EU-, OESO- en de Berne Union. Waar gepast neem je ook zelf deel aan deze overleggen. Je coördineert surveys en internationale rapportageverplichtingen. Je draagt bij aan de formulering van jaarplannen, bereidt Nederlandse standpunten en internationale overleggen voor, en coördineert hierin dossiers met collega’s en de Staat. Je volgt internationale ontwikkelingen, beoordeelt de betekenis daarvan voor de Nederlandse ekv en helpt deze te vertalen naar beleid en uitvoering. Op eigen dossiers vertegenwoordig je, in afstemming met senior collega’s en de Staat, mede de Nederlandse standpunten in internationale gremia.
Stakeholdermanagement: je brengt partijen met verschillende belangen bij elkaar, bouwt duurzame werkrelaties op en creëert draagvlak, ook wanneer je geen hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid hebt.

Jouw Profiel

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding en 2-5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in een beleidsfunctie, consultancy, financiële dienstverlening, een overheidsorganisatie of een internationale omgeving.
Beleidsmatig en projectmanagement: je combineert inhoudelijke beleidsvaardigheid met aantoonbare ervaring in het zelfstandig organiseren en leiden van projecten. Je kunt schakelen tussen analyse, afstemming, besluitvorming en implementatie.
Je bent analytisch en omgevingsbewust: je maakt je nieuwe dossiers snel eigen, overziet verschillende belangen en begrijpt hoe politieke, economische en uitvoeringsaspecten elkaar beïnvloeden.
Je bent sterk in schrijven en communiceren: je schrijft heldere en overtuigende adviezen en kunt complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Verbindend en resultaatgericht: je brengt gemakkelijk verschillende partijen bij elkaar, neemt eigenaarschap en weet projecten vooruit te brengen zonder formele autoriteit. Affiniteit met publiek beleid, internationale economische vraagstukken, exportfinanciering en/of financiële dienstverlening is belangrijk; kennis van het Nederlandse publieke handelsinstrumentarium is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Atradius kun je rekenen op een leuke en uitdagende plek om te werken: internationaal, dynamisch en informeel. We bevinden ons in een strategische transitie gericht op het stimuleren van verduurzaming van de Nederlandse export en investeringen in het buitenland. Met de Nederlandse staat als opdrachtgever werken we vaak aan projecten met een maatschappelijke invalshoek. Dit biedt een interessante mix tussen het leveren van een bedrijfseconomische en sociaal-maatschappelijke bijdrage. We vinden het belangrijk onze mensen een omgeving te bieden waarin ze persoonlijke groei kunnen realiseren. Atradius biedt aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder een marktconform salaris, 13e maand, variabele beloning, goede pensioenregeling en een hybride werkomgeving.

Gelijke kansen voor iedereen

Het succes van onze organisatie staat of valt met de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de ideeën die zij hebben. Echt verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen voor onze klanten ontstaan door een samenspel van culturen, kennis en ervaring. Daarom is diversiteit voor onze organisatie ontzettend belangrijk. Om ervoor te zorgen dat alle collega’s binnen Atradius DSB hun kwaliteiten kunnen ontplooien, stimuleren we een diverse en inclusieve cultuur waarin iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt. Kandidaten die bijdragen aan die diversiteit worden dan ook van harte uitgenodigd te reageren. 

Enthousiast en wil je solliciteren?

Dat kan via onderstaande button!
