new_jobs.title: Information Security Manager (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Über uns

Unsere Motivation sind Softwarelösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kund*innen wirklich erleichtern und sie erfolgreicher machen. Das schaffen wir mit einem einzigartigen Team, Leidenschaft für Technologien, Mut für ausgefallene Wege und sehr viel Herzlichkeit, Ambition und Spaß bei der Arbeit.
Dein Team

Wir im internen IT-Team sorgen dafür, dass alle technischen Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren – von Hardware, Software und Netzwerken über zentrale Dienste wie Active Directory bis hin zu modernen Cloud-Services. Wir stellen die sichere und zuverlässige IT-Infrastruktur für alle Mitarbeitenden bereit, entwickeln Lösungen für effizientes Arbeiten und sind zentrale Anlaufstelle bei Fragen rund um IT und Informationssicherheit. Mit einem klaren Fokus auf Stabilität, Sicherheit und Innovation schaffen wir die Basis für produktives Arbeiten und den Schutz unserer Unternehmensinformationen.

Aufgaben

Informationssicherheit ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern ein Thema, für das du brennst. Du kennst die wachsenden Herausforderungen, bewegst dich sicher zwischen Risiko, Governance und Technik und willst Security im Unternehmen wirksam voranbringen.
Du betreibst und entwickelst unser Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem (ISMS) weiter – von Policies und Risikomanagement bis Awareness und Reporting.
Du koordinierst ISO-27001-/TISAX-Audits, externe Reviews und Zertifizierungen und begleitest die Bearbeitung der Findings.
Du koordinierst Security Assessments für Lieferanten, Services, Tools, AI Use Cases und Kundenanforderungen.
Du bringst bereichsübergreifende Security-Initiativen voran, übersetzt Risiken in konkrete Maßnahmen und behältst deren Umsetzung im Blick.
Du verbindest unser Information Security Governance Board mit den Business Units, Corporate Functions, technischen Expert*innen und externen Partnern; bei Blockern sorgst du für Klarheit und Eskalation.

Profil

Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Informationssicherheit mit und kennst dich fundiert mit Informationssicherheitsmanagement, ISO 27001 und Security Governance aus.
Ein gutes technisches Security-Verständnis zeichnet dich aus – insbesondere in den Bereichen Cloud, AI, Endpoint und Softwareentwicklung.
Du hast Erfahrung im Risiko-, Audit-, Maßnahmen- und Projektmanagement.
Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit liegt dir: Du kommunizierst klar, koordinierst souverän und bleibst bei der Nachverfolgung verbindlich.
Du kannst technische, regulatorische und Management-Perspektiven zusammenbringen und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Wir bieten

Home Office, Workation, Fahrrad-Leasing oder das perfekte Teilzeitmodell für dich. Unsere Benefits begleiten dich in deinem Arbeitsalltag bei itdesign und bieten dir vieles, was auch nach Feierabend Spaß macht und dein Leben verschönert.
Onboarding

Wir bereiten alles für deinen Start bei itdesign vor und geben dir alles an die Hand, damit du deine Aufgaben und Kolleg*innen kennenlernen kannst. Dabei helfen dir dein*e Mentor*in, dein individueller Einarbeitungsplan, Kennenlerngespräche und Schnupperpraktika.
Flexibel

Ob 40 Stunden oder dein individuelles Teilzeitmodell – wir gehen flexibel auf deine Bedürfnisse ein. All deine Stunden werden in einem Arbeitszeitkonto erfasst; Überstunden kannst du abfeiern.
Büro & Home Office

Wir freuen uns, wenn du ins Büro kommst. Genauso gerne darfst du auch im Home Office arbeiten. Manche Jobs sind auch zu 100% remote aus überall in Deutschland möglich. Egal wo dein Schreibtisch steht, wir versorgen dich mit Hardware.
Erholen & Workation

Du kannst es dir mit 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub bei besonderen Ereignissen gut gehen lassen. Außerdem kannst du Workation am Urlaubsort deiner Wahl machen.
Umweltbewusst

Ob Jobticket, Fahrrad-Leasing, Ökostrom oder eine eigene Solaranlage – Nachhaltigkeit ist uns wichtig. Daher haben wir eine CO2-Bilanz erstellt und arbeiten Schritt für Schritt daran, unseren Fußabdruck zu verkleinern.
Gesund

Wir dürfen dem itdesign Nikolauslauf unseren Namen schenken und freuen uns, wenn du mitläufst. Laufen ist nichts für dich? Dann vielleicht Yoga, Volleyball, unser Online Fitnessstudio oder du probierst bei den Gesundheitstagen was ganz Neues aus.
Gut abgesichert

Mit einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung sorgen wir dafür, dass du im Alltag gut versorgt bist. Auch dann, wenn es über die Standardleistungen hinausgeht.
Genießen

Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und Snacks wie Obst, Gemüse und Süßigkeiten brauchen wir alle und gehören zu jedem guten Bürotag dazu. Highlight der Woche: Kuchendienstag!
Sozial

Wir sind Teil der Gesellschaft, daher ist es uns wichtig, dass wir uns engagieren. Dazu gehören Spenden, Blutspenden, oder dass wir bei Team-Events z. B. ein Hochbeet für eine Schule bauen. Mach einfach mit und tu Gutes!
Feiern

Wir feiern Feste, wie sie fallen und du bist vom ersten Tag an ein Teil davon, egal ob Wasen, Weihnachten oder Jahres-Kickoff. Jedes Jahr machen wir mit ganz itdesign einen dreitägigen Ausflug z. B. in die Berge oder nach Paris.
Familie

Damit du Job und Familie gut unter einen Hut bringen kannst, kannst du in Teilzeit arbeiten, Home Office nutzen oder deinen Nachwuchs ins Büro bringen und unser Eltern-Kind-Zimmer nutzen. In deiner Elternzeit bekommst du einen Elternzeitpaten.
Jobticket

Unser Hauptsitz ist mitten im schönen Tübingen, daher ist auch der Bahnhof direkt um die Ecke. Mit dem Jobticket kannst du bequem ins Büro fahren oder für Ausflüge in deiner Freizeit nutzen.
Shopping

Du hast Zugang zu zahlreichen Rabatten bei bekannten Marken und Shops. Ob Reisen, Mode, Technik oder Mobilfunk; du kannst aus vielen exklusiven Angeboten wählen und bei deinen Einkäufen richtig sparen.
Radeln

Mit dem Fahrrad ins Büro oder einfach am Abend an der frischen Luft auspowern? Das kannst du ganz einfach mit deinem geleasten Fahrrad über itdesign machen.
Weiterbilden

Freitag ist Schulungstag und wir teilen intern unser Wissen miteinander. Außerdem haben wir alle einen jährlichen Kostenrahmen, welchen du für deine individuelle Weiterbildung nutzen kannst.
Job Shadowing

Du begleitest ein anderes Team und bekommst Einblicke in unterschiedliche Rollen und Arbeitsweisen. Dabei lernst du neue Methoden und Tools kennen, entwickelst dich weiter und baust bereichsübergreifendes Wissen auf.
Beteiligung

Da wir alle zum Erfolg von itdesign beitragen, gibt es jedes Jahr zusätzlich zum Gehalt eine Gewinnbeteiligung für alle.
Vorsorgen

Damit du dir um deine Zukunft keine Sorgen machen musst, unterstützen wir dich bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
Flach & schnell

Wir arbeiten schnell, unkompliziert und auf direktem Dienstweg miteinander. Dabei sprechen wir viel miteinander, sind offen und geben einander Feedback.
Remote dabei

Unser Remote Ambassador kümmert sich darum, dass auch remote arbeitende Kolleg*innen sich verbunden fühlen und im Alltag dabei sind.

Important note

Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services. We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

As we scale, our Operations organisation needs to scale with us. We are therefore looking for an additional Global Operations Analyst to join the team and to help us build smarter workflows, make better decisions and turn ideas into measurable results across every market.

This role sits at the intersection of data, AI, operations and execution. You will be part of the Global Operations teaam and work closely with local Operations Directors and Managing Directors, while partnering with teams across Product, Tech, Commercial and Finance.

Our role in Global Operations is to support local teams, not make decisions on their behalf. You will give Operations Directors and Managing Directors the analysis, tools and perspectives they need to make strong decisions for their markets, while helping & implementing successful ideas scale across Flatpay.

What You'll Do

Your work will vary significantly from week to week. One week, you might build & optimize a staffing model with a local Operations Director to help understand how many people a market needs as it grows. The next, you might analyse how AI can remove manual work from a customer service process, investigate an urgent escalation or help turn a commercial opportunity into a workflow used by hundreds of agents. You will not only identify problems. In most cases, you will also help implement the solution.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

Support cost to serve and staffing decisions, working with local Operations Directors and Managing Directors to understand workload, productivity, service levels and future staffing needs
Use AI to improve operational workflows, identifying repetitive or manual work that can be automated and helping turn the opportunity into something that works in practice
Get hands on with operational escalations, digging into complex issues, finding the root cause and coordinating the right people until the problem is resolved
Build and maintain core Operations reporting, providing markets and senior stakeholders with a clear view of performance, trends and areas requiring action
Lead operational analysis and improvement projects, covering areas such as NPS, contact volumes, productivity, customer behaviour, queue performance and agent workflows
Turn analysis into execution, translating findings into clear recommendations and helping markets implement the changes
Support urgent and recurring operational requests, switching comfortably between longer term projects and issues requiring an immediate response

Who You Are

You enjoy working at the intersection of analysis and execution. You are comfortable getting into the details, but you can also step back, understand the wider business impact and explain what should happen next. You take ownership naturally. If something is unclear, you investigate it. If a process is not working, you challenge it. If you identify an opportunity, you help make it happen.

We Imagine That You

Have 1 to 3 years of experience in operations, a startup, a scaleup, consulting or a strategy role
Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable using Excel and Claude to identify patterns, build models and support decisions
Are interested in AI and how it can improve real operational workflows
Enjoy switching between deep analysis, stakeholder management and urgent operational problem solving
Are comfortable working with senior stakeholders across different markets and functions
Are proactive, accountable and motivated by measurable results
Have a genuine get shit done attitude
Are fluent in English and Danish, both verbally and in writing

Why Flatpay

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Role: Business Analyst

You should apply if you have:

• A sharp, curious mind - you instinctively ask why a number moved, where exactly it moved, and what it's costing the business, instead of just reporting it
• 2–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Operations/Strategy Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar in e-commerce, D2C, consumer internet, or any fast-moving business where you've worked with real operational data
• Comfort with data - you can pull and slice data with SQL and Excel/Sheets, and turn it into a clear answer
• A structured way of breaking down messy, ambiguous problems into hypotheses, analysis, and a recommendation
• Ownership - you don't stop at 'I shared the analysis'; you follow through with teams until the fix is in and the metric has moved
• An AI-first way of working - you use LLMs and other AI tools to move faster, automate the boring parts, and prototype ideas
• Hunger to learn new domains fast - we'll give you a detailed knowledge transfer on how our business and operations run; the curiosity
and drive to master it need to come from you

You should not apply if you:

• Want a pure reporting role - here you're expected to interpret the numbers, take a view, and drive action on them
• Are looking to run day-to-day operations - this is an analytics and intelligence role that informs the business, not an ops role
• Need every problem to be perfectly defined before you start - much of this role is figuring out what the problem actually is
• Treat your job as done once a dashboard or deck ships - we care about whether the metric moved

Skills Required:

Must-Have

• SQL: comfortable writing queries to pull, join, and analyze operational data
• Excel / Google Sheets: strong enough to model, slice, and sanity-check numbers quickly
• Structured Problem Solving: breaking an ambiguous problem into hypotheses, data, root cause, and recommendation
• Business Sense: connecting an operational metric to revenue, margin, cost, or customer experience
• Communication: turning complex analysis into a simple story - what happened, why, impact, and what to do next
• Ownership & Follow-through: working across teams until an action actually reaches closure

Good to Have

• Experience in e-commerce operations - across D2C, quick commerce, marketplaces, or consumer internet
(a strong plus, not a requirement)
• A BI tool such as Power BI, Metabase, Tableau, or Looker
• Exposure to operations data such as logistics, inventory, fulfilment, or customer support
• Basic Python for scripting and automation
• Experience using AI tools or vibe coding to automate analysis and build quick internal tools

What will you do?

Be the Go-To for Business Numbers

• Own reporting and dashboards across key business and operational areas - the single trusted source of truth teams rely on
• Give each function the right data cuts to make their day-to-day decisions
Monitor and Catch Problems Early

• Closely track key business and operational KPIs so you're the first to know when something breaks - a delivery delay, a spike in cancellations or RTO, a drop in availability
• Build early-warning indicators and flag anomalies to the right teams before they turn into escalations
Dig into Root Causes

• Investigate why metrics move - across products, customers, geographies, partners, and processes - and quantify the impact
• Take problems from insight to root cause to a clear recommendation
Solve Core Business Problems (Initial Focus: Fulfilment, Logistics & Inventory)

• Fulfilment and courier allocation - which location and partner should serve which order
• Inventory availability - reducing stockouts and excess stock
• COD and RTO risk - spotting risky orders and pin codes early
• Cancellations and customer experience - understanding what drives them and where automation can help
• Vendor performance - giving procurement a data-backed view of when to rely more on a vendor and when to de-risk
• Your scope will broaden across the business as you grow into the role
Turn Insights into Projects and Track Them to Impact

• For every recommendation, define the baseline, target KPI, owner, and timeline upfront
• Bring the right teams together, drive the action, and check afterwards whether the change actually moved the metric

The Associate Carrier Operations Analyst, Outbound Logistics oversees and optimizes finished vehicle transportation across truck, rail, and ocean modes. Our Mission Goes Beyond Simply Increasing Cross-use Metrics. We Lead The Following Areas To Maximize The Brand Value Of The "Rakuten Group," Elevate Its Impact, And Strengthen The Bond Between Users And Rakuten

Embodying Brand Identity: Reconstructing Rakuten’s powerful assets within a brand strategy context. We design unified brand communication and experiences across the entire group.
Accelerating Cross-Use through User Experience: Leveraging data-driven analysis and collaborating with each business unit to visualize the "emotional value" of using Rakuten’s services, thereby driving cross-use through the power of our brand.
Building a "Rakuten" Design Foundation: Our creative team establishes design systems and UI/UX standards, ensuring that users feel the "Rakuten identity" across every service, embedding our world-view into society.
Group Marketing: Orchestrating all marketing channel strategies from a group-wide perspective to lead the design of optimal experiences at every user touchpoint.

We are looking for individuals to join us in this challenge—using the power of marketing to leave a mark on our massive ecosystem and ensuring "Rakuten" remains an indispensable presence for our users.

Department Overview

The Data & Insights Group utilizes data from across the Rakuten Group to rigorously measure the Return on Investment (ROI) of marketing initiatives and provide recommendations for budget optimization, driving profitability for the entire group.

We are an essential function for the future of Rakuten’s marketing, moving beyond basic attribute data to create precise segments based on behavioral history and purchase intent. We design marketing initiatives to provide personalized experiences for every customer and share these best practices across the group.

Position

Why We Hire

We are expanding our team to strengthen our organizational capabilities in both "offensive" and "defensive" marketing strategies. This role offers the opportunity to build a career on a scale that overlooks Rakuten's diverse services, with potential for further advancement within the cross-functional organization or into specific business units.

Problem Solving through Data Analysis: Utilize Rakuten’s vast user data, behavioral logs, and advanced analytical environment (Big Query, Databricks, BI tools, etc.).
Effectiveness Validation: Calculate and verify the impact of new service launches (may include coordinating with external research).
Dashboard Design & Development: Use Big Query and BI tools (DOMO, Tableau, Looker, etc.) to process data and build automated, scalable KPI monitoring platforms.
Strategic Recommendations: Support ad-hoc data extraction and hypothesis testing; structure analysis results into compelling narratives for presentations to drive decision-making.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with marketing teams and developers to provide data-driven insights and support strategic initiatives.

Mandatory Qualifications

3+ years of practical experience in data extraction, processing, and aggregation using SQL.
3+ years of experience in data processing and dashboard development on Big Query using BI tools (Tableau, Looker, DOMO, etc.).

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. Contribute to innovative approaches that make performance insights more accessible and actionable for business users.

This is a hands-on specialist role that combines technical implementation, data analysis, and business insight generation. Success requires the ability to move seamlessly between troubleshooting digital measurement frameworks and explaining how customer behaviour and platform usage influence commercial outcomes.

Required Qualifications

What You'll Need to Be Successful

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3-5 years of relevant professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, digital measurement, business intelligence, or a similar analytics role.
Strong hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, including events, conversions, tagging strategies, data layers, and measurement implementation.
Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting digital measurement solutions with working knowledge of JavaScript, pixels, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement.
Strong analytical skills with experience analysing customer journeys, website performance, digital campaigns, and conversion behaviour.
Experience building dashboards, reports, data models, and measures in Power BI.
Working knowledge of SQL and data transformation tools such as Power Query, KNIME, or similar platforms.
Ability to translate business questions into meaningful measurement frameworks, analyses, and actionable recommendations.

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

Experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage:

Salesforce and commercial/customer data analytics.
Analytics related to AI platforms, digital products, or internal technology adoption.
Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, Jasper AI, or other Generative AI technologies.
Data preparation and modelling for AI-supported analytics and natural-language querying.
Experience working within global enterprise environments and cross-functional teams.

Who You Are

You are:

Hands-on and analytical – You enjoy working directly with data, measurement technologies, and uncovering the story behind the numbers.
Problem-solving – You identify root causes and develop practical solutions to measurement, tracking, and analytics challenges.
Business-oriented – You connect data and insights to customer experience, commercial performance, and business outcomes.
Collaborative – You build strong partnerships across commercial, marketing, product, data, and technology teams.
Curious and innovative – You continuously explore emerging digital and AI technologies and convert ideas into practical improvements.

Créée en 1989, SCALIAN compte aujourd’hui plus de 5500 collaborateurs répartis dans 11 pays et 15 implantations en France pour un chiffre d’affaires de 550 millions d’euros. SCALIAN travaille pour des grands Groupes du CAC40 sur des projets en AT ou au forfait.

Labellisée Great Place to Work, SCALIAN connaît une croissance de 20% chaque année.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Parce que Scalian vous accompagne dans le développement de votre carrière : Programme d'onboarding complet sur 1 an avec votre manager et votre RH, programmes de formation personnalisés, communautés techniques, événements internes

Parce que Scalian favorise la Qualité de Vie au Travail : Certifications Great Place to Work® et Best Workplaces for Women, Prime de cooptation, prime vacances, Accord télétravail.

Parce que Scalian développe une politique RSE concrète et ambitieuse : Mobilité durable, Actions environnementales, Accord Handicap et mission handicap avec temps dédié.

Description Du Poste

Un rôle Corporate et international au cœur de la transformation data-driven de la fonction RH, combinant gouvernance de la donnée, Power BI, pilotage social, contrôle budgétaire et recommandations stratégiques.

Finalité du poste

Le/la HR Data Analyst Corporate / People Analytics est le/la référent/e de la donnée RH au niveau Groupe. Il/elle garantit la disponibilité, la fiabilité, la cohérence, la sécurité et l'exploitabilité des données RH issues des pays et des différents systèmes. Il/elle industrialise les reportings internes et externes, développe les dashboards Power BI destinés notamment au COMEX et transforme la donnée en analyses et recommandations permettant d'éclairer les décisions en matière d'effectifs, de rémunération, de diversité, d'absentéisme, de fidélisation et de performance RH.

Le poste combine une forte dimension de gouvernance de la donnée, de production automatisée, de contrôle de gestion sociale et de conseil aux décideurs. Il contribue à la mise en place de standards Groupe et accompagne les équipes locales dans leur appropriation.

Le poste joue également un rôle clé dans la mise en place du SIRH Groupe : définition des données et KPI, contrôles de qualité, recette des rapports, migration des reportings manuels et développement progressif des nouveaux rapports directement dans l’outil.

Responsabilités principales :

Gouvernance et ownership de la donnée RH Groupe
Définir et maintenir le référentiel Groupe des données RH, des KPI, des règles de gestion, des sources et des responsabilités associées.
Assurer l'ownership fonctionnel de la donnée RH sur l'ensemble de son cycle de vie, de la collecte à l'archivage et à la restitution.
Organiser la collecte et la consolidation des données provenant des pays, entités, SIRH, solutions de paie, ATS, LMS et autres outils métiers.
Mettre en place une gouvernance claire avec les data owners et data stewards locaux, incluant calendrier, contrôles, documentation et processus d'escalade.
Garantir l'homogénéité des définitions et leur bonne application dans les reportings et analyses Groupe.
Qualité, fiabilité et traçabilité des données
Concevoir des contrôles automatisés de complétude, cohérence, unicité, exactitude et fraîcheur des données.
Piloter la résolution des anomalies avec les équipes RH, Paie, SIRH et Finance et suivre les plans de remédiation.
Définir et suivre des indicateurs de qualité de données, avec seuils d'alerte et reporting régulier aux parties prenantes.
Documenter les règles de calcul, sources, dépendances et limites des indicateurs afin d'assurer leur auditabilité.
Contribuer aux projets d'évolution du SIRH et des interfaces pour fiabiliser la captation de la donnée à la source.
Industrialisation du reporting et dashboards Power BI
Concevoir, développer, publier et maintenir des dashboards Power BI robustes, ergonomiques et adaptés aux différents publics.
Automatiser l'alimentation, la consolidation, les contrôles et la diffusion des reportings afin de réduire les traitements manuels.
Produire les tableaux de bord exécutifs destinés au COMEX et à la Direction des Ressources Humaines Groupe.
Mettre à disposition des vues adaptées aux pays, HRBP et centres d'expertise, dans le respect des habilitations et règles de confidentialité.
Définir les standards de visualisation, de versioning, de documentation et de maintenance des solutions analytiques RH.
Reporting social, réglementaire et extrafinancier
Produire les reportings sur les effectifs et ETP, entrées et sorties, turnover, absentéisme, mobilité, formation, compétences et performance des processus RH.
Construire les analyses de rémunération, d'augmentations, d'équité salariale et de Total Reward.
Contribuer à la production des indicateurs sociaux extrafinanciers, notamment CSRD et ESG.
Sécuriser la piste d'audit, la justification des méthodes de calcul et la réconciliation des chiffres publiés.
Répondre aux besoins de données des audits internes, externes et demandes institutionnelles relevant du périmètre RH.
Contrôle budgétaire des effectifs Staff
Contribuer à la construction du budget annuel des effectifs Staff, en lien avec Finance et les responsables de fonctions.
Assurer le suivi mensuel Réalisé / Budget / Forecast des effectifs, ETP, mouvements, postes vacants.
Analyser les écarts par pays, entité, fonction, niveau et centre de coûts, puis préparer les éléments des revues budgétaires.
Élaborer des projections et scénarios d'évolution des effectifs et coûts, intégrant recrutements, départs, absences et mobilités.
Développer les dashboards Power BI permettant un pilotage partagé des effectifs et du budget Staff.
People Analytics et recommandations
Dépasser la production descriptive en réalisant des analyses explicatives, prédictives ou de segmentation lorsque les données le permettent.
Identifier les tendances sur la rémunération, la diversité, l'absentéisme, l'engagement, le turnover et la fidélisation.
Protection des données et sécurité des flux
Appliquer les exigences du RGPD et les politiques internes de protection des données personnelles RH.
Intégrer les principes de minimisation, limitation des finalités, durée de conservation et privacy by design dans les traitements et reportings.
Définir et contrôler les habilitations, règles d'accès et niveaux de confidentialité des données et dashboards.
Veiller à la sécurisation des interfaces, extractions, transferts et flux de données, notamment internationaux, avec l'IT, et le DPO.
Alerter et escalader tout incident, faiblesse de contrôle ou risque de non-conformité identifié sur le périmètre.

Livrables clés

Dictionnaire des données et catalogue des KPI RH Groupe.
Dashboards Power BI COMEX, DRH Groupe, pays et fonctions RH.
Pack mensuel de pilotage des effectifs et principaux indicateurs sociaux.
Reporting CSRD / ESG et dossiers de justification associés.
Tableau de bord de qualité de la donnée et plans de remédiation.
Analyses thématiques.

Qualifications

Profil recherché

Formation Bac+5 en data, statistiques, contrôle de gestion sociale, économie, ressources humaines, école d'ingénieurs ou de commerce avec spécialisation quantitative.
Expérience de 3 à 5 ans minimum en HR Data, People Analytics, contrôle de gestion sociale ou fonction comparable dans un environnement multi-entités, idéalement international.
Maîtrise avancée de Power BI, incluant modélisation de données, Power Query et DAX. Très bonne maîtrise d'Excel.
Connaissance des environnements SIRH, paie, ATS et LMS et des problématiques d'interfaces et de qualité des données.
Bonne maîtrise des KPI RH, des données d'effectifs et de rémunération et des mécanismes budgétaires Staff.
Connaissance des enjeux CSRD / ESG et du RGPD appliqué aux données RH.
Une pratique de SQL, Python, outils ETL ou plateformes data constitue un atout.
Anglais professionnel courant, capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs de différents pays.

Compétences comportementales

Rigueur, fiabilité et sens élevé de la confidentialité.
Esprit analytique, capacité à challenger les chiffres et à aller à la cause racine.
Orientation business et capacité à transformer une analyse en recommandation actionnable.
Autonomie, sens de l'ownership et capacité à structurer un sujet de bout en bout.
Pédagogie et aptitude à rendre simples des analyses complexes pour un public dirigeant.
Capacité d'influence dans un environnement transverse et international.
Curiosité, amélioration continue et appétence pour l'automatisation et l'innovation.

Positionnement et niveau d’autonomie

Le/la titulaire agit comme référent/e opérationnel/le de la donnée RH Groupe. Il/elle propose les standards, coordonne les contributeurs, challenge la qualité des données et dispose d'une autonomie forte dans la conception des solutions analytiques. Les décisions juridiques, de cybersécurité et de politique RH restent portées par les fonctions expertes compétentes, avec lesquelles il/elle travaille étroitement.

Kern Community College District

Location: Bakersfield College -- Panorama Campus, CA

Department: Institutional Effectiveness

Below is our job description for this position. Please also review the Important Instructions & Additional Information section below, which contains valuable information about our application process.

Basic Function

Under the direction of an assigned supervisor, perform institutional research and evaluation duties,; design and perform research and evaluation of programs, student groups, and colleges; support college personnel in fulfilling data reporting for compliance requirements; Support grant applicates with data reports.

The Senior Institutional Research Analyst applies an advanced knowledge of research methodology and analytical techniques to design, coordinate, and manage a wide range of research and reporting projects, which may involve the coordination of the efforts of multiple personnel; performs all phases of research, assessment, and evaluation studies, including problem definition, study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation and presentation of findings; consults with the campus community to determine research needs. The Senior Institutional Research Analyst is distinguished from the Institutional Research Analyst by their responsibility for coordinating and leading designated research functions within the department.

Representative Duties

Perform and lead statistical and technical planning, design, research, and evaluation duties related to institutional projects.

Lead the process of evaluating academic and student services programs.

Determine and utilize appropriate statistical procedures and sampling techniques to ensure high levels of confidence and reliability in survey analyses and research projects.

Oversee and prepare reports for college personnel and state agencies to fulfill compliance regulations and requirements and to assure institutional matriculation effectiveness for appropriate funding.

Design, implement, and evaluate survey results, including communication of results to the campus community.

Research, identify sources, and prepare and revise reports with accompanying tabular, graphical, and statistical contents, descriptions of analytical methods used and narrative of findings and conclusions.

Query institutional databases related to student enrollment projections, follow-up studies and analyses of program enrollment patterns.

Conduct qualitative research, such as focus groups and individual interviews.

Create, develop, and maintain databases related to student enrollment projections, follow-up studies and analyses of program enrollment patterns.

Provide expert support, consultation, and analysis for enrollment management, equity, and student success initiatives; provide requested data and suggest additional data and analyses, as appropriate

Develop and share code for use in data preparation and analysis.

Create project and database documentation.

Provide guidance and support to institutional research analysts, data coaches, and other personnel on how to access, interpret, and communicate data and research findings.

Extract data from a variety of external data sets and data marts such as the CCCCO Data Mart, Census, Bureau of Labor Statistics, CSU Analytics, COCI, Assist.org, etc.

Use a variety of software packages for data analysis, data collation, data management, graphics, and word processing (e.g., Tableau, R, SPSS, Cognos, Excel, PowerPoint).

Communicate with appropriate college staff, stakeholders and other community college districts in analysis, compilation, and interpretation of data.

Prepares research agendas and calendars; tracks progress of research projects.

Respond to research questions as requested; describe findings.

Serve on committees and attend meetings as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination equivalent to: Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, or social/educational research and five years responsible experience involving related research and analysis activities and projects.

Knowledge & Abilities

KNOWLEDGE OF

Standard and advanced statistical procedures related to sampling, correlation analysis, projections and other quantitative measures applied to education, social, and program research and evaluation.

Effective public speaking.

Effective written communication skills.

Social Science Research Methodology design for original data collection and analysis.

Use of personal computers and appropriate software packages.

Use of statistical, data querying, and data visualization software

Technical report writing.

Organization and presentation of narrative and statistical information.

Technical aspects of research.

Uses, capabilities, characteristics and limitations of computers and related equipment.

California Community College initiatives.

Survey sampling, design, and research.

Qualitative and quantitative data analyses techniques.

Inferential and descriptive statistics.

ABILITY TO

Learn, interpret, and apply institutional, state, and federal regulations, legal mandates, policies, rules, and guidelines to a variety of operational procedures.

Perform extensive and technical research and evaluation tasks.

Design forms and documents for various research purposes and target audiences.

Conduct research, collect, compile, assemble, and report a variety of data and information used for analysis of institutional planning issues, decision making, trend monitoring, reports, and publications.

Learn new ideas, procedures, processes, and computer software quickly and independently.

Perform appropriate statistical analyses and interpret results and findings.

Review input and output data to assure accuracy and efficiency.

Establish priorities, plan, and organize a variety of work assignments.

Interact, participate, and conduct presentations to individuals, college groups, committees, organizations, and others as assigned.

Prepare comprehensive statistical and narrative reports.

Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive and privileged material and information.

Utilize accurate and appropriate statistical procedures and sampling techniques.

Create, develop, and maintain computer databases.

Create and maintain necessary research documentation, files and records related to research projects.

Conduct meetings and interviews necessary for investigation and data collection.

Work as a team member with other college research staff.

Use tact, patience, and courtesy.

Operate a computer and related peripheral equipment.

Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

Demonstrate clear evidence of sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, staff, and the community.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Arkadiko Partners is a strategy and management consulting firm, assisting all types of institutional investors in developing and aligning business and investment strategy, sustainability and stewardship to create long-term value. 

Since 2017 we have supported clients with over USD 11 trillion in aggregate invested assets, in developing and implementing their strategies for asset management, sustainability and stewardship.

Our clients include smaller boutique active equities-only asset managers to some of the world’s largest financial institutions, with complex organisational structures and investment activities across both public and private markets. Our deep experience and understanding of the needs of institutional investors, combined with specific and practical experience in responsible and sustainable investment make us particularly effective in promoting value-enhancing change for our clients. 
We are currently looking for a passionate and purpose-driven business analyst, who will support client projects, assisting them in tackling their most critical challenges and navigating the complex and rapidly evolving areas of stewardship and sustainable investment.

Role Description
As business analyst, you will undertake desk research, gather data and perform analytical work within client projects. You will participate in client meetings and present recommendations to senior colleagues as well as contributing to project coordination. 
The role of business analyst carries a high degree of responsibility and independence. You will be part of a small and dynamic team, working closely with your colleagues on client projects, including: preparing for client meetings; undertaking research and due diligence; conducting market and peer analyses; evaluating investors’ stewardship and sustainable investment activities, and related marketing materials and reporting. You will play an active role in uncovering opportunities and overcoming challenges for clients. 

While you will be individually responsible for managing priorities and meeting deadlines, there is a strong culture of collaboration within our team and you will have the opportunity to learn from your colleagues and industry experts within our network. You will gain experience of stewardship and sustainability in investment and an understanding of best practices in investor engagement, voting, and integrating sustainability into investment models.

We will support your continued development, including studies towards further qualifications, such as the IMC, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant post-graduate degrees.

Key responsibilities

Client work:
Prepare materials in support of senior colleagues, including client deliverables and background analyses, and contribute to indentifying potential solutions to challenges faced by clients.
Assist in reviewing and assessing client materials, including procedure documents, policies, reporting, and regulatory submissions (e.g., UK Stewardship Code).
Undertake market and benchmarking analyses of asset managers and asset owners.
Support senior colleagues in preparing for meetings with clients, including drafting agendas and presentations, and preparing for interviews.
Assist in preparing responses to client requests and other inquiries.
Support in coordinating projects, maintaining oversight and clearly communicating progress to ensure deadlines are consistently met.
Undertake research into market developments and assist in maintaining and further developing the firm’s knowledge.
Support senior colleagues in developing industry initiatives, planning and coordinating networking sessions.

Business development:
Support business development activities, including contributing to pitch materials and drafting proposals. 
Update and maintain our CRM system, ensuring interactions with prospects are captured and recorded.
Undertake research into new business development opportunities, such as company research and analysis.

Academic and training support:
Update training and educational course materials, ensuring they remain accurate and relevant.

Internal business activities:
Support internal business activities, such as marketing and communications initiatives, as required.
Assist in preparing presentations for senior colleagues speaking at industry events or lectures.

Qualifications

A significant degree of initiative and self-management is required in this role. Therefore, time management and personal discipline are vital, as is the ability to work to short deadlines and under pressure.
Strong (written and spoken) English communication skills are required. Other languages are considered a plus. High proficiency in business writing.
Ability to work effectively both as a team player and independently. 
Ability to be flexible, dynamic and support with other business related activities as necessary.
Educated to relevant master’s degree level (or equivalent), with a strong interest in investment management, stewardship, and sustainability.
Work experience in strategy consulting or investment management would be beneficial.
Keen learner who is looking to develop new skills and enhance existing ones.
Advanced user of Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.)

Employment status
Permanent, Full time (four days per week)

Work location
Hybrid – London. We are committed to providing flexibility and balance to our employees, offering the opportunity for working remotely and from a shared office space in central London. We would expect a minimum of two days per week in the office.

Working hours
Normal working hours are 9am to 5pm UK time (inclusive of a lunch break of one hour) from Monday to Thursday (4 days/week). Flexibility is expected during busy periods.

Right to work in the UK You must have the permanent right to work in the UK as Arkadiko Partners will not be considering applications where employer visa sponsoring is (or will be) required.

Salary
Competitive remuneration package. Salary appropriate for the experience and combination of skills required for the role. Arkadiko Partners operates an annual discretionary bonus scheme based on assessment of performance and linked to company performance.

Benefits
20 days’ paid holiday in each holiday year, or the pro equivalent for any period worked part time, together with the usual public holidays in England and Wales.

You will be eligible for the following benefits (some of which are available after successful completion of a probation period):
Company pension 
Private medical insurance
Life insurance
Annual medical assessment 
Bike2Work Scheme

How to apply
Interested applicants should send their CV and Cover Letter in a combined document (The cover letter should be of no more than one page, approximately 500 words. It should explain why you are interested in joining Arkadiko and the role for which you are applying, and highlight the experiences, skills and perspectives that you believe are most relevant. We are particularly interested in understanding why this opportunity appeals to you and what you believe you could contribute to the team. Please avoid simply repeating information contained in your CV. If you use generative AI tools, please include a brief statement at the end of the cover letter describing how you used them).

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are only able to contact candidates who have been selected to progress to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Je opereert zelfstandig op executive niveau en schakelt intensief met senior stakeholders binnen Finance, Risk, Data & Analytics en Operations. Je zorgt voor samenhang tussen strategische programma's, bewaakt risico's en afhankelijkheden en vertaalt complexe regelgeving naar concrete, meetbare resultaten.

Naast BCBS 239 richt je je op onderwerpen als ESG, AI-ready data, datakwaliteit en operationele efficiëntie.

Wat ga je doen

Coördineren van de organisatiebrede datamanagementroadmap, met nadruk op BCBS 239.
Aansturen en bewaken van strategische implementatieprogramma's binnen een complexe bancaire omgeving.
Sturen op mijlpalen, risico's, afhankelijkheden en naleving van regelgeving.
Adviseren van senior management en C-level stakeholders over voortgang, knelpunten en strategische keuzes.
Vertalen van ambities rondom BCBS 239, ESG en AI-ready data naar concrete resultaten.
Signaleren en oplossen van belemmeringen tussen verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen.
Opstellen van voortgangsrapportages, managementinformatie en besluitvormingsdocumenten.
Creëren van draagvlak en afstemming tussen Finance, Risk, Operations en Data & Analytics.

Wat breng je mee?

Voor deze opdracht zoeken wij een ervaren programmamanager met diepgaande kennis van datamanagement binnen de financiële dienstverlening en ervaring in complexe stakeholderomgevingen.

Een afgeronde masteropleiding (WO).
Minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als senior programma- of roadmapmanager op executive niveau.
Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring met datamanagement binnen de financiële dienstverlening.
Aantoonbare ervaring met de bankbrede implementatie van BCBS 239 binnen een grote bancaire organisatie.
Recente BCBS 239-ervaring, bij voorkeur opgedaan in de afgelopen 3 jaar.
Ervaring met het zelfstandig aansturen van complexe, organisatiebrede programma's.
Ervaring met programmamanagementtools en rapportagesoftware.
Uitstekende advies-, communicatie- en presentatievaardigheden.
Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Kennis van ESG-datamanagement en AI-ready data.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een strategisch sterke, zelfstandige programmamanager die gewend is te opereren op directie- en bestuursniveau. Je overziet complexe belangen, brengt structuur aan en weet besluitvorming op het hoogste niveau te beïnvloeden.

Je werkt hybride, met minimaal twee dagen per week op kantoor in Utrecht. Woensdag is een verplichte kantoordag.

As the Program Manager, Recruiting Enablement, you will design, build, and deliver the training that helps Datadog’s recruiters, sourcers, coordinators, and hiring managers do their best work, including how they use AI across the hiring process. You’ll turn new tools, processes, and AI workflows into e-learning, live sessions, and job aids that people use on the job, then keep them running in our learning platform. You’ll partner closely with our Senior Enablement Program Manager to shape the enablement roadmap. You’ll have a real say in what gets built and why, while owning the design and quality of everything we ship. This is an opportunity to shape how a growing global team learns, and to grow your craft in instructional design, facilitation, and AI-assisted content creation.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

Own the recruiting onboarding experience and development track as programs in their own right — scope, design, delivery, and results
Partner with the Recruiting Enablement team on the roadmap, intake, and prioritization, bringing your own read on where the team’s gaps are
Design learning across the recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to interviewing and closing, including how teams apply AI to sourcing, screening, scheduling, and candidate communication — and where human judgment still has to lead
Partner with our AI Enablement leader to bring AI programming to the recruiting team — translating broader AI initiatives into recruiting-specific training, and surfacing what recruiters actually need back to that roadmap
Build e-learning in Articulate Rise 360 and Storyline, plus facilitator guides, job aids, videos, and knowledge checks, using AI tools to speed up production
Facilitate live training, virtually and in person, for teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and coach subject matter experts to deliver sessions themselves
Support the rollout of new tools and processes with training plans, launch communications, and office hours that help people adopt them
Run our team's day-to-day work in Docebo, our learning management system, as the first point of contact for learner questions: publish courses and learning plans, package SCORM content, troubleshoot issues, and partner with our Learning Technology team on releases and escalations
Measure what's working through completion, confidence, and manager-reported readiness, and keep content current with clear owners, source files, and review dates
Continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of the program — content refreshes, automation, and better measurement of what actually moves recruiter performance

Who You Are:

4+ years in instructional design, enablement, learning and development, or talent acquisition, including time building training for a recruiting or People team
Have a portfolio of curricula, e-learning, and job aids you designed and shipped, and a record of running several projects at once
Skilled in Articulate Rise 360 or Storyline and grounded in adult learning methods such as ADDIE or SAM
An engaging facilitator who can hold a room of experienced recruiters, in person and virtually, and build trust with partners you don't manage
Hands-on experience with an enterprise learning management system, including course setup, enrollments, SCORM, reporting, and troubleshooting
Fluent with AI in your own practice — you use it to draft, storyboard, generate assessments, produce media, and cut build time, and you can show the before and after
Able to judge where AI belongs in a hiring process and where it doesn’t, with a working understanding of the bias, candidate experience, and consistency risks that come with it
Able to break complex problems into smaller pieces and design practical solutions, grounded in internal data, industry best practices, and adult learning principles
Highly organized with strong attention to detail, and able to prioritize well in an environment with competing demands
Comfortable operating globally — designing for regional nuance across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC rather than exporting a single-market program
Experienced developing or coaching people leaders is a strong plus
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment
